16.name: Caterpie
16.dex_entry: Caterpie has a voracious appetite. It can devour leaves that are larger than its own body. From its antenna, this Pokémon releases a terrifically strong odor.

17.name: Metapod
17.dex_entry: Its shell is hard, but it's still just a bug shell. It's been known to break, so intense battles with it should be avoided.

18.name: Butterfree
18.dex_entry: The wings are protected by rain-repellent dust. As a result, this Pokémon can fly about even in rain.

19.name: Weedle
19.dex_entry: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

20.name: Kakuna
20.dex_entry: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

21.name: Beedrill
21.dex_entry: They may appear in a swarm. Beedrill flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

21.2.name: Mega Beedrill
21.2.dex_entry: Its legs have become poison stingers. It stabs its prey repeatedly with the stingers on its limbs, dealing the final blow with the stinger on its rear.

22.name: Pidgey
22.dex_entry: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

23.name: Pidgeotto
23.dex_entry: This Pokémon has a sprawling territory and will fiercely peck at any intruder.

24.name: Pidgeot
24.dex_entry: It flies over water as it hunts, skimming along the surface to catch Magikarp and other such prey.

24.2.name: Mega Pidgeot
24.2.dex_entry: With its muscular strength now greatly increased, it can fly continuously for two weeks without resting.

25.name: Rattata
25.dex_entry: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.

25.2.name: Alolan Rattata
25.2.dex_entry: It shows no interest in anything that isn't fresh. If you take it shopping with you, it will help you pick out ingredients.

26.name: Raticate
26.dex_entry: Raticate's sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.

26.2.name: Alolan Raticate
26.2.dex_entry: This gourmet Pokémon is particular about the taste and freshness of its food. Restaurants where Raticate live have a good reputation.

27.name: Spearow
27.dex_entry: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

28.name: Fearow
28.dex_entry: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.

29.name: Ekans
29.dex_entry: As it matures, it grows longer. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

30.name: Arbok
30.dex_entry: To intimidate foes, it spreads its chest wide and makes eerie sounds by expelling air from its mouth.

31.name: Pichu
31.dex_entry: It is unskilled at storing electric power. Any kind of shock causes it to discharge energy spontaneously.

32.name: Pikachu
32.dex_entry: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. When in a tough spot, this Pokémon discharges electricity.

33.name: Raichu
33.dex_entry: If it stores too much electricity, its behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this, it occasionally discharges excess energy and calms itself down.

33.2.name: Alolan Raichu
33.2.dex_entry: This Pokémon rides on its tail while it uses its psychic powers to levitate. It attacks with star-shaped thunderbolts.

33.3.name: Mega Raichu X
33.3.dex_entry: It resembles an X as it flies through the air with 50 million volts of electricity sparking from its ears and forked tail.

33.4.name: Mega Raichu Y
33.4.dex_entry: It fires bolts of electricity from the tip of its tail and from the spiky tufts of fur growing out of its temples. This electricity forms the letter Y.

34.name: Sandshrew
34.dex_entry: It digs deep burrows to live in. When in danger, it rolls up its body to withstand attacks.

34.2.name: Alolan Sandshrew
34.2.dex_entry: It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel shell is very hard—so much so, it can't roll its body up into a ball.

35.name: Sandslash
35.dex_entry: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.

35.2.name: Alolan Sandslash
35.2.dex_entry: It uses large, hooked claws to cut a path through deep snow as it runs. On snowy mountains, this Sandslash is faster than any other Pokémon.

36.name: Nidoran♀
36.dex_entry: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.

37.name: Nidorina
37.dex_entry: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

38.name: Nidoqueen
38.dex_entry: Nidoqueen's body is encased in extremely hard scales. This Pokémon is at its strongest when it is defending its young.

39.name: Nidoran♂
39.dex_entry: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

40.name: Nidorino
40.dex_entry: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

41.name: Nidoking
41.dex_entry: Nidoking's thick tail packs enormously destructive power. Once this Pokémon goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

42.name: Cleffa
42.dex_entry: On nights with many shooting stars, they gather in packs and dance in circles.

43.name: Clefairy
43.dex_entry: On nights with a full moon, Clefairy gather from all over and dance. Bathing in moonlight makes them float.

44.name: Clefable
44.dex_entry: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

44.2.name: Mega Clefable
44.2.dex_entry: It flies by using the power of moonlight to control gravity within a radius of over 32 feet around it.

45.name: Vulpix
45.dex_entry: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

45.2.name: Alolan Vulpix
45.2.dex_entry: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

46.name: Ninetales
46.dex_entry: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

46.2.name: Alolan Ninetales
46.2.dex_entry: The reason it guides people all the way down to the mountain's base is that it wants them to hurry up and leave.

47.name: Igglybuff
47.dex_entry: Igglybuff loves to sing. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.

48.name: Jigglypuff
48.dex_entry: When this Pokémon sings, it never pauses to breathe. If it is in a battle against an opponent that does not easily fall asleep, Jigglypuff cannot breathe, endangering its life.

49.name: Wigglytuff
49.dex_entry: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!

50.name: Zubat
50.dex_entry: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echolocation to flit about in darkness.

51.name: Golbat
51.dex_entry: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

52.name: Crobat
52.dex_entry: Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.

53.name: Oddish
53.dex_entry: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

54.name: Gloom
54.dex_entry: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

55.name: Vileplume
55.dex_entry: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

56.name: Bellossom
56.dex_entry: A Bellossom grows flowers more beautifully if it has evolved from a smelly Gloom—the more stinky the better. At night, this Pokémon closes its petals and goes to sleep.

57.name: Paras
57.dex_entry: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. No matter how much it eats, they steal away most of the nutrients it consumes.

58.name: Parasect
58.dex_entry: Parasect is controlled by a mushroom that has grown larger than its host's body. The Pokémon scatters poisonous spores.

59.name: Venonat
59.dex_entry: Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be active in darkness. The eyes can also shoot powerful beams.

60.name: Venomoth
60.dex_entry: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.

61.name: Diglett
61.dex_entry: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops. Many farmers cherish and nurture it because its droppings enrich the soil it lives in.

61.2.name: Alolan Diglett
61.2.dex_entry: Its golden whiskers function as sensors. It pokes them out of its burrow to monitor its surroundings.

62.name: Dugtrio
62.dex_entry: While the three of them normally get along splendidly, on rare occasions a huge fight will break out over which head gets to eat first.

62.2.name: Alolan Dugtrio
62.2.dex_entry: Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It's reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.

63.name: Meowth
63.dex_entry: It loves shiny things. It often fights with Murkrow over prey they're both trying to catch.

63.2.name: Alolan Meowth
63.2.dex_entry: It's impulsive, selfish, and fickle. It's very popular with some Trainers who like giving it the attention it needs.

63.3.name: Galarian Meowth
63.3.dex_entry: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth.

64.name: Persian
64.dex_entry: Getting this prideful Pokémon to warm up to you takes a lot of effort, and it will claw at you the moment it gets annoyed.

64.2.name: Alolan Persian
64.2.dex_entry: In contrast to its lovely face, it's so brutal that it tortures its weakened prey rather than finishing them off.

65.name: Perrserker
65.dex_entry: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

66.name: Psyduck
66.dex_entry: If its usual headache worsens, it starts exhibiting odd powers. It can't remember doing so, however.

67.name: Golduck
67.dex_entry: Old tales tell of Golduck punishing those that defiled its river. The guilty were dragged into the water and taken away.

68.name: Mankey
68.dex_entry: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages, and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.

69.name: Primeape
69.dex_entry: It has been known to become so angry that it dies as a result. Its face looks peaceful in death, however.

70.name: Annihilape
70.dex_entry: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

71.name: Growlithe
71.dex_entry: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

71.2.name: Hisuian Growlithe
71.2.dex_entry: They patrol their territory in pairs. The igneous rock components in the fur of this species are believed to be the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

72.name: Arcanine
72.dex_entry: The fire burning inside its body serves as the energy to fuel it as it runs great distances. It appears in many legends.

72.2.name: Hisuian Arcanine
72.2.dex_entry: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

73.name: Poliwag
73.dex_entry: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon's innards showing through the skin.

74.name: Poliwhirl
74.dex_entry: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.

75.name: Poliwrath
75.dex_entry: It's quite a gifted swimmer, even among Water-type Pokémon, but it normally spends its time on land.

76.name: Politoed
76.dex_entry: The curled hair on Politoed's head is proof of its status as a king. It is said that the longer and more curled the hair, the more respect this Pokémon earns from its peers.

77.name: Abra
77.dex_entry: Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger, it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.

78.name: Kadabra
78.dex_entry: If it uses its abilities, it emits special alpha waves that cause machines to malfunction.

79.name: Alakazam
79.dex_entry: Alakazam's highly developed brain is on par with a supercomputer. Its brain cells multiply continually until it dies. As a result, it remembers everything.

79.2.name: Mega Alakazam
79.2.dex_entry: Having traded away its muscles, Alakazam's true power has been unleashed. With its psychic powers, it can foresee all things.

80.name: Machop
80.dex_entry: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

81.name: Machoke
81.dex_entry: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

82.name: Machamp
82.dex_entry: With four arms, it can attack and defend simultaneously. It quickly swings them to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

83.name: Bellsprout
83.dex_entry: It plants its feet deep underground to rehydrate itself. While doing so, it's unable to run away if it's attacked.

84.name: Weepinbell
84.dex_entry: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

85.name: Victreebel
85.dex_entry: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

85.2.name: Mega Victreebel
85.2.dex_entry: The volume of this Pokémon's acid has increased due to Mega Evolution, filling its mouth. If it's not careful, the acid will overflow and spill out.

86.name: Tentacool
86.dex_entry: Its body is 99% water. The remaining 1% contains the organ that makes its poison. When the tide goes out, dehydrated Tentacool can be found left behind on the shore.

87.name: Tentacruel
87.dex_entry: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and contract freely. It alerts others to danger by stridently flashing the red orbs on its head.

88.name: Geodude
88.dex_entry: Commonly found near mountain trails and the like. If you step on one by accident, it gets angry.

88.2.name: Alolan Geodude
88.2.dex_entry: Its stone head is imbued with electricity and magnetism. If you carelessly step on one, you'll be in for a painful shock.

89.name: Graveler
89.dex_entry: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

89.2.name: Alolan Graveler
89.2.dex_entry: This Pokémon's entire body is tinged with electricity due to the stones it likes to eat. It's very quick-tempered.

90.name: Golem
90.dex_entry: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.

90.2.name: Alolan Golem
90.2.dex_entry: It uses magnetism to accelerate and fire off rocks tinged with electricity. Even if it doesn't score a direct hit, the jolt of electricity will do the job.

91.name: Ponyta
91.dex_entry: Ponyta is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. This Pokémon becomes stronger by stumbling and falling to keep up with its parent.

91.2.name: Galarian Ponyta
91.2.dex_entry: Its small horn hides a healing power. With a few rubs from this Pokémon's horn, any slight wound you have will be healed.

92.name: Rapidash
92.dex_entry: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

92.2.name: Galarian Rapidash
92.2.dex_entry: Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.

93.name: Slowpoke
93.dex_entry: Slowpoke is incredibly slow and dopey, and it takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack. It is good at fishing with its tail.

93.2.name: Galarian Slowpoke
93.2.dex_entry: Although this Pokémon is normally zoned out, its expression abruptly sharpens on occasion. The cause for this seems to lie in Slowpoke's diet.

94.name: Slowbro
94.dex_entry: Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.

94.2.name: Mega Slowbro
94.2.dex_entry: When bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution, Shellder converts into impregnable armor. There is virtually no change in Slowpoke.

94.3.name: Galarian Slowbro
94.3.dex_entry: If this Pokémon squeezes the tongue of the Shellder biting it, the Shellder will launch a toxic liquid from the tip of its shell.

95.name: Slowking
95.dex_entry: Slowking undertakes research every day in an effort to solve the mysteries of the world. However, this Pokémon apparently forgets everything it has learned if the Shellder on its head comes off.

95.2.name: Galarian Slowking
95.2.dex_entry: A combination of toxins and the shock of evolving has increased Shellder's intelligence to the point that Shellder now controls Slowking.

96.name: Magnemite
96.dex_entry: The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.

97.name: Magneton
97.dex_entry: A Magneton is actually three Magnemite linked by magnetism. A group of these Pokémon can set off a magnetic storm.

98.name: Magnezone
98.dex_entry: Exposure to a special magnetic field changed Magneton's molecular structure, turning it into Magnezone. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.

99.name: Farfetch'd
99.dex_entry: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

99.2.name: Galarian Farfetch'd
99.2.dex_entry: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

evolution.name: Sirfetch'd
evolution.method: Landing 3 critical hits in a single battle

100.name: Sirfetch'd
100.dex_entry: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

evolution.name: Sirfetch'd
evolution.method: Landing 3 critical hits in a single battle

101.name: Doduo
101.dex_entry: Its twin heads have exactly the same genes and battle in perfect sync with each other.

102.name: Dodrio
102.dex_entry: The strongest head with the thickest neck becomes the leader and gains primary control of the body. It now has three hearts and three sets of lungs.

103.name: Seel
103.dex_entry: This Pokémon lives on icebergs. It uses the sharp point on its head to break up ice as it swims in the sea.

104.name: Dewgong
104.dex_entry: It stores thermal energy in its body to fend off the cold. It swims at eight knots even in frigid waters.

105.name: Grimer
105.dex_entry: Grimer's sludgy and rubbery body can be forced through any opening, however small it may be. This Pokémon enters sewer pipes to drink filthy wastewater.

105.2.name: Alolan Grimer
105.2.dex_entry: It has a passion for trash above all else, speedily digesting it and creating brilliant crystals of sparkling poison.

106.name: Muk
106.dex_entry: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact. They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge accumulates, making the stench around them worse.

106.2.name: Alolan Muk
106.2.dex_entry: What look like fangs and claws are actually crystallized poison that will afflict you at a mere touch, so don't get too close.

107.name: Shellder
107.dex_entry: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

108.name: Cloyster
108.dex_entry: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

109.name: Gastly
109.dex_entry: Gastly is largely composed of gaseous matter. When exposed to a strong wind, the gaseous body quickly dwindles away. Groups of this Pokémon cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.

110.name: Haunter
110.dex_entry: It strikes at humans from total darkness. Those licked by its cold tongue grow weaker with each passing day until they die.

111.name: Gengar
111.dex_entry: Deep in the night, your shadow cast by a streetlight may suddenly overtake you. It is actually a Gengar running past you, pretending to be your shadow.

111.2.name: Mega Gengar
111.2.dex_entry: It can pass through other dimensions and appear anywhere. It caused a stir one time when it stuck just one leg out of a wall.

112.name: Onix
112.dex_entry: Onix has a magnet in its brain. It acts as a compass so that this Pokémon does not lose direction while it is tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes increasingly rounder and smoother.

113.name: Steelix
113.dex_entry: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

113.2.name: Mega Steelix
113.2.dex_entry: To protect itself from opponents' attacks, it uses magnetism to control pieces of its hard outer shell that have flaked off.

114.name: Drowzee
114.dex_entry: If you think that you had a good dream but you can't remember it, a Drowzee has probably eaten it.

115.name: Hypno
115.dex_entry: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.

116.name: Krabby
116.dex_entry: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.

117.name: Kingler
117.dex_entry: Kingler has an enormous, oversized claw that it waves in the air to communicate with others. However, because the claw is so heavy, the Pokémon quickly tires.

118.name: Voltorb
118.dex_entry: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

118.2.name: Hisuian Voltorb
118.2.dex_entry: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

119.name: Electrode
119.dex_entry: Electrode eats electricity in the atmosphere. On days when lightning strikes, you can see this Pokémon exploding all over the place from eating too much electricity.

119.2.name: Hisuian Electrode
119.2.dex_entry: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

120.name: Exeggcute
120.dex_entry: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

121.name: Exeggutor
121.dex_entry: Each of its three heads has its own thoughts. When they want to go in different directions, Exeggutor becomes unable to move. If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.

121.2.name: Alolan Exeggutor
121.2.dex_entry: It swings its long neck like a whip and smacks its head into opponents. This makes Exeggutor itself a little dizzy too.

122.name: Cubone
122.dex_entry: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

123.name: Marowak
123.dex_entry: It throws bones at Mandibuzz to knock it down. It's thought that Marowak is trying to avenge its parent.

123.2.name: Alolan Marowak
123.2.dex_entry: It has transformed the spirit of its dear departed mother into flames, and tonight it will once again dance in mourning of others of its kind.

124.name: Tyrogue
124.dex_entry: This earnest Pokémon battles all sorts of opponents, searching for the fighting style that suits it best.

125.name: Hitmonlee
125.dex_entry: It has complete control over the ligaments in its legs, expanding and contracting them to double the reach of its kicks.

126.name: Hitmonchan
126.dex_entry: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

127.name: Hitmontop
127.dex_entry: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

128.name: Lickitung
128.dex_entry: If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on you and you don't clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won't go away, either.

129.name: Lickilicky
129.dex_entry: Lickilicky can do just about anything with its tongue, which is as dexterous as the human hand. In contrast, Lickilicky's use of its fingers is clumsy.

130.name: Koffing
130.dex_entry: The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit lighter than air. That's why it's always slightly airborne.

131.name: Weezing
131.dex_entry: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found

131.2.name: Galarian Weezing
131.2.dex_entry: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

132.name: Rhyhorn
132.dex_entry: Rhyhorn runs in a straight line, smashing everything in its path. It is not bothered even if it rushes headlong into a block of steel. This Pokémon may feel some pain from the collision the next day, however.

133.name: Rhydon
133.dex_entry: Rhydon has a horn that serves as a drill. It is used for destroying rocks and boulders. This Pokémon occasionally rams into streams of magma, but the armor-like hide prevents it from feeling the heat.

134.name: Rhyperior
134.dex_entry: It can load up to three projectiles per arm into the holes in its hands. What launches out of those holes could be either rocks, Geodude or Roggenrola.

135.name: Happiny
135.dex_entry: Mimicking Chansey, Happiny will place an egg-shaped stone in its belly pouch. Happiny will treasure this stone.

136.name: Chansey
136.dex_entry: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people. Those eggs used as a high-class cooking ingredient.

137.name: Blissey
137.dex_entry: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

138.name: Tangela
138.dex_entry: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

139.name: Tangrowth
139.dex_entry: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

140.name: Kangaskhan
140.dex_entry: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down. There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

141.2.name: Mega Kangaskhan
141.2.dex_entry: Its child has grown rapidly, thanks to the energy of Mega Evolution. Mother and child show off their harmonious teamwork in battle.

142.name: Horsea
142.dex_entry: It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.

143.name: Seadra
143.dex_entry: The male raises the young. If it is approached while caring for young, it will use its toxic spines to fend off the intruder.

144.name: Kingdra
144.dex_entry: Kingdra lives at extreme ocean depths that are otherwise uninhabited. It has long been believed that the yawning of this Pokémon creates spiraling ocean currents.

145.name: Goldeen
145.dex_entry: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

146.name: Seaking
146.dex_entry: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. The Pokémon defends its eggs with its life.

147.name: Staryu
147.dex_entry: This Pokémon gets nibbled on by Lumineon and others. Thanks to its red core, it regenerates fast, so it's unconcerned by their snack attacks.

148.name: Starmie
148.dex_entry: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. At the center of its body is a red core that sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

148.2.name: Mega Starmie
148.2.dex_entry: Its movements have become more humanlike. Whether it's simply trying to communicate or wants to supplant humanity is unclear.

149.name: Mime Jr.
149.dex_entry: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

150.name: Mr. Mime
150.dex_entry: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

150.2.name: Galarian Mr. Mime
150.2.dex_entry: It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet. It'll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a frozen floor.

151.name: Mr. Rime
151.dex_entry: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements and releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

152.name: Scyther
152.dex_entry: As Scyther fights more and more battles, its scythes become sharper and sharper. With a single slice, Scyther can fell a massive tree.

153.name: Scizor
153.dex_entry: Bulky pincers account for one third of Scizor's body weight. A single swing of one of these pincers will crush a boulder completely.

153.2.name: Mega Scizor
153.2.dex_entry: It's better at beating things than grasping them. When it battles for a long time, the weight of its pincers becomes too much to bear.

154.name: Kleavor
154.dex_entry: This Pokémon is a rough, crude, and violent sort. It swings around its large, heavy stone axes to finish off its prey.

155.name: Smoochum
155.dex_entry: When it examines things, before touching them with its hands, it makes lip contact and then diligently licks all the dirt off its lips.

156.name: Jynx
156.dex_entry: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

157.name: Elekid
157.dex_entry: It's not good at storing electricity yet. This Pokémon sneaks into people's homes, looking for electrical outlets to eat electricity from.

158.name: Electabuzz
158.dex_entry: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.

159.name: Electivire
159.dex_entry: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

160.name: Magby
160.dex_entry: This Pokémon is still small and timid. Whenever Magby gets excited or surprised, flames leak from its mouth and its nose.

161.name: Magmar
161.dex_entry: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

162.name: Magmortar
162.dex_entry: Magmortar takes down its enemies by shooting fireballs, which burn them to a blackened crisp. It avoids this method when hunting prey.

163.name: Pinsir
163.dex_entry: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

163.2.name: Mega Pinsir
163.2.dex_entry: After Mega Evolution, it becomes able to fly. With its vaunted horns, it can lift an opponent 10 times heavier than itself and fly about with ease.

164.name: Tauros
164.dex_entry: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protectors take pride in their battle-scarred horns.

164.2.name: Paldean Tauros - Combat
164.2.dex_entry: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

164.3.name: Paldean Tauros - Blaze
164.3.dex_entry: People call this kind of Tauros the Blaze Breed due to the hot air it snorts from its nostrils. Its three tails are intertwined.

164.4.name: Paldean Tauros - Aqua
164.4.dex_entry: It swims by jetting water from its horns. The most notable characteristic of the Aqua Breed is its high body fat, which allows it to float easily.

165.name: Magikarp
165.dex_entry: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

166.name: Gyarados
166.dex_entry: Once Gyarados goes on a rampage, its ferociously violent blood doesn't calm until it has burned everything down. There are records of this Pokémon's rampages lasting a whole month.

166.2.name: Mega Gyarados
166.2.dex_entry: Mega Evolution places a burden on its body. The stress causes it to become all the more ferocious. It jets water from the orifices on its sides, streaking above the water surface at supersonic speed.

167.name: Lapras
167.dex_entry: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

168.name: Ditto
168.dex_entry: While it can transform into anything, each Ditto apparently has its own strengths and weaknesses when it comes to transformations.

169.name: Eevee
169.dex_entry: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

170.name: Vaporeon
170.dex_entry: It prefers beautiful shores. With cells similar to water molecules, it could melt in water.

171.name: Jolteon
171.dex_entry: Every hair on its body starts to stand sharply on end if it becomes charged with electricity.

172.name: Flareon
172.dex_entry: When it catches prey or finds berries, it breathes fire on them until they're well done, and then it gobbles them up.

173.name: Espeon
173.dex_entry: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions. The orb on its forehead glows when it uses psychic power.

174.name: Umbreon
174.dex_entry: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it's filled with a mysterious power.

175.name: Leafeon
175.dex_entry: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

176.name: Glaceon
176.dex_entry: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.

177.name: Sylveon
177.dex_entry: This Pokémon uses its ribbonlike feelers to send a soothing aura into its opponents, erasing their hostility

178.name: Soileon
178.dex_entry: It has a sleek fur that resembles soil and rock. It can dig through the hardest ground with ease.

179.name: Graveon
179.dex_entry: Graveon is known to lurk in abandoned graveyards. It is often seen by people who recently experienced the loss of a loved one.

180.name: Porygon
180.dex_entry: Porygon is an artificial Pokémon created using advanced scientific means. It can move freely through cyberspace.

181.name: Porygon2
181.dex_entry: AI has been installed in it. It learns various things all on its own, but it even remembers things it doesn't need to know.

182.name: Porygon-Z
182.dex_entry: Its behavior is noticeably unstable, which is apparently due to the incompetence of the engineer who updated its programming.

183.name: Omanyte
183.dex_entry: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it's just drifting along.

184.name: Omastar
184.dex_entry: Weighed down by a large and heavy shell, Omastar couldn't move very fast. Some say it went extinct because it was unable to catch food.

185.name: Kabuto
185.dex_entry: This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabuto molt every three days, making their shells harder and harder.

186.name: Kabutops
186.dex_entry: Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.

187.name: Aerodactyl
187.dex_entry: In ancient times, it ruled the skies. A widely accepted theory is that it went extinct due to a large meteor impact.

187.2.name: Mega Aerodactyl
187.2.dex_entry: Mega Evolution awakened some dormant genes, bringing back the sharp rocks that once covered Aerodactyl's entire body.

188.name: Munchlax
188.dex_entry: It needs to consume its own weight in food every day. Whether the food is rotten or fresh, yummy or tasteless—it does not care.

189.name: Snorlax
189.dex_entry: Snorlax's typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. Its stomach's digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison, so eating things off the ground doesn't bother it at all.

190.name: Dratini
190.dex_entry: Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowing water, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls. As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.

191.name: Dragonair
191.dex_entry: This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on its tail and controls the weather. When enshrouded by an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.

192.name: Dragonite
192.dex_entry: It's a kindhearted Pokémon. If it spots a drowning person or Pokémon, Dragonite simply must help them.

192.2.name: Mega Dragonite
192.2.dex_entry: Mega Evolution has excessively powered up this Pokémon's feelings of kindness. It finishes off its opponents with mercy in its heart.

193.name: Sentret
193.dex_entry: If it encounters a foe, it will stand up on its tail, making itself look bigger than usual to intimidate them.

194.name: Furret
194.dex_entry: It is nimble and has a very flexible body. Even if you get ahold of it, it'll slip right out of your arms.

195.name: Hoothoot
195.dex_entry: It always stands on one foot. Even when attacked, it does not brace itself using both feet. It cries at the same time every day.

196.name: Noctowl
196.dex_entry: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark. If it flips its head upside down, it's a sign that it is engaged in very complex thinking.

197.name: Ledyba
197.dex_entry: They are timid and grow uneasy when not in a swarm with others of their kind. The pattern on their backs differs slightly from one to another.

198.name: Ledian
198.dex_entry: It's said that the patterns on its back are related to the stars in the night sky, but the details of that relationship remain unclear.

199.name: Spinarak
199.dex_entry: It spins a web using fine yet durable thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped. Some fishers weave its sturdy thread into nets to catch fish Pokémon.

200.name: Ariados
200.dex_entry: Every night, it wanders around in search of prey, whose movements it restrains by spewing threads before it bites into them with its fangs.

201.name: Chinchou
201.dex_entry: It lives in ocean depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

202.name: Lanturn
202.dex_entry: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

203.name: Togepi
203.dex_entry: It is considered to be a symbol of good luck. Its shell is said to be filled with happiness.

204.name: Togetic
204.dex_entry: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

205.name: Togekiss
205.dex_entry: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they've hardly been seen at all.

206.name: Natu
206.dex_entry: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

207.name: Xatu
207.dex_entry: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

208.name: Mareep
208.dex_entry: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

209.name: Flaaffy
209.dex_entry: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. Flaaffy can fire wool that zaps on impact.

210.name: Ampharos
210.dex_entry: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

210.2.name: Mega Ampharos
210.2.dex_entry: Massive amounts of energy intensely stimulated Ampharos's cells, apparently awakening its long-sleeping dragon's blood.

211.name: Azurill
211.dex_entry: The ball on Azurill's tail bounces like a rubber ball, and it's full of the nutrients the Pokémon needs to grow.

212.name: Marill
212.dex_entry: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water. The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

213.name: Azumarill
213.dex_entry: Azumarill's long ears are indispensable sensors. By focusing its hearing, this Pokémon can identify what kinds of prey are around, even in rough and fast-running rivers.

214.name: Bonsly
214.dex_entry: From its eyes, it can expel excess moisture from its body. The liquid is similar in composition to human sweat. This makes it appear to be crying.

215.name: Sudowoodo
215.dex_entry: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.

216.name: Hoppip
216.dex_entry: Outside of cold regions, Hoppip can be found practically everywhere. This is because the wind carries this species all over the world.

217.name: Skiploom
217.dex_entry: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

218.name: Jumpluff
218.dex_entry: Jumpluff travels on seasonal winds. Once its cotton spores run out, its journey ends, as does its life.

219.name: Aipom
219.dex_entry: Its tail moves with greater dexterity than its hands. Making deft use of this tail, Aipom lives high among the treetops.

220.name: Ambipom
220.dex_entry: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things that Ambipom rarely uses its hands.

221.name: Sunkern
221.dex_entry: It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to shake its leaves desperately at its attacker. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.

222.name: Sunflora
222.dex_entry: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.

223.name: Yanma
223.dex_entry: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without the Pokémon moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

224.name: Yanmega
224.dex_entry: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

225.name: Wooper
225.dex_entry: When the temperature cools in the evening, they emerge from water to seek food along the shore.

225.2.name: Paldean Wooper
225.2.dex_entry: It's dangerous for Wooper to travel alone. They line up in groups of three or four and help each other as they walk around the wetlands.

226.name: Quagsire
226.dex_entry: Its body is always slimy. Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on riverbed boulders and boat hulls as it swims but seems not to care.

227.name: Clodsire
227.dex_entry: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps.

228.name: Murkrow
228.dex_entry: Seen as a symbol of bad luck, it's generally disliked. Yet it gives presents—objects that sparkle or shine—to Trainers it's close to.

229.name: Honchkrow
229.dex_entry: It will absolutely not forgive failure from or betrayal by its goons. It has no choice in this if it wants to maintain the order of the flock.

230.name: Misdreavus
230.dex_entry: It gets nourishment from fear that it absorbs into its red orbs. During the daytime, it sleeps in the shadows.

231.name: Mismagius
231.dex_entry: It chants incantations. While these incantations can torment targets, some bring happiness.

232.name: Unown
232.dex_entry: Because the Pokémon is shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether written language or Unown came first. They are always found stuck on walls.

233.name: Wynaut
233.dex_entry: Wynaut gather on moonlit nights to play by squeezing up against each other. By being squeezed, this Pokémon gains endurance and is trained to dole out powerful counterattacks.

234.name: Wobbuffet
234.dex_entry: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

235.name: Girafarig
235.dex_entry: Its tail has a separate small brain. The tail bites to repel any foe trying to sneak up on the Pokémon from behind.

236.name: Farigiraf
236.dex_entry: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

237.name: Pineco
237.dex_entry: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.

238.name: Forretress
238.dex_entry: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

239.name: Dunsparce
239.dex_entry: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

240.name: Dudunsparce
240.dex_entry: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

241.name: Dududunsparce
241.dex_entry: The gentle Dududunsparce will put Pokémon that wander into its nest onto its back and carry them to the entrance.

242.name: Gligar
242.dex_entry: Gligar glides through the air without a sound as if it were sliding. This Pokémon hangs on to the face of its foe using its clawed hind legs and the large pincers on its forelegs, then injects the prey with its poison barb.

243.name: Gliscor
243.dex_entry: It flies soundlessly through the sky. It catches prey with its long tail, then lunges at the prey's vulnerable spots with its fangs.

244.name: Snubbull
244.dex_entry: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

245.name: Granbull
245.dex_entry: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

246.name: Qwilfish
246.dex_entry: Qwilfish sucks in water, inflating itself. This Pokémon uses the pressure of the water it swallowed to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming somewhat challenging.

246.2.name: Hisuian Qwilfish
246.2.dex_entry: It absorbs toxins from the food it eats. The distinct purple spikes on its body are evidence of its potent poison.

247.name: Overqwil
247.dex_entry: It's ferocious and has a short temper. The ends of its spikes are barbed, and they can't be easily removed once they've punctured something.

248.name: Shuckle
248.dex_entry: Shuckle quietly hides itself under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its hard shell while eating berries it has stored away. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.

249.name: Heracross
249.dex_entry: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

249.2.name: Mega Heracross
249.2.dex_entry: A tremendous influx of energy builds it up, but when Mega Evolution ends, Heracross is bothered by terrible soreness in its muscles.

250.name: Sneasel
250.dex_entry: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.

250.2.name: Hisuian Sneasel
250.2.dex_entry: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

251.name: Weavile
251.dex_entry: They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.

252.name: Sneasler
252.dex_entry: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

253.name: Teddiursa
253.dex_entry: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.

254.name: Ursaring
254.dex_entry: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

255.name: Ursaluna
255.dex_entry: It is believed that swampy terrain gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

255.2.name: Ursaluna - Bloodmoon
255.2.dex_entry: This special Ursaluna can see in the dark with its left eye and protects itself with mud that is as hard as iron.

256.name: Slugma
256.dex_entry: Molten magma courses throughout Slugma's circulatory system. If this Pokémon is chilled, the magma cools and hardens. Its body turns brittle and chunks fall off, reducing its size.

257.name: Magcargo
257.dex_entry: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

258.name: Swinub
258.dex_entry: It searches for food by digging into the ground with its snout. Even frozen ground doesn't give it any trouble.

259.name: Piloswine
259.dex_entry: Its shaggy coat makes it unable to see. It checks surroundings with its sensitive nose instead.

260.name: Mamoswine
260.dex_entry: This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.

261.name: Corsola
261.dex_entry: Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes. Thankfully, Corsola grows it back in just one night.

261.2.name: Galarian Corsola
261.2.dex_entry: Watch your step when wandering areas oceans once covered. What looks like a stone could be this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.

262.name: Cursola
262.dex_entry: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

263.name: Remoraid
263.dex_entry: This Pokémon clings to Mantine and shares in its prosperity. When its Mantine is attacked, Remoraid will fight alongside it!

264.name: Octillery
264.dex_entry: The ink it spits when escaping is special. It contains a substance that dulls the sense of smell, so Pokémon with keen noses get lost.

265.name: Delibird
265.dex_entry: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has a habit of sharing food with people lost in the mountains.

266.name: Mantyke
266.dex_entry: Mantyke are friendly toward people and will approach boats closely. The patterns on their backs differ depending on their habitat.

267.name: Mantine
267.dex_entry: Many people have taken up surfing because they admire how magnificently Mantine swims.

268.name: Skarmory
268.dex_entry: The wing feathers it sheds can be processed and made into knives whose sharpness is recognized by the finest chefs.

268.2.name: Mega Skarmory
268.2.dex_entry: It flies faster than the speed of sound. After whipping up shock waves to send enemies flying, it finishes them off with its talons.

269.name: Houndour
269.dex_entry: It cooperates with others skillfully. When it becomes your partner, it's very loyal to you as its Trainer and will obey your orders.

270.name: Houndoom
270.dex_entry: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

270.2.name: Mega Houndoom
270.2.dex_entry: Its red claws and the tips of its tail are melting from high internal temperatures that are painful to Houndoom itself.

271.name: Phanpy
271.dex_entry: Phanpy uses its long nose to shower itself. When others gather around, they thoroughly douse each other with water. These Pokémon can be seen drying their soaking-wet bodies at the edge of water.

272.name: Donphan
272.dex_entry: Donphan's favorite attack is curling its body into a ball, then charging at its foe while rolling at high speed. Once it starts rolling, this Pokémon can't stop very easily.

273.name: Stantler
273.dex_entry: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

274.name: Wyrdeer
274.dex_entry: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

275.name: Smeargle
275.dex_entry: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

276.name: Miltank
276.dex_entry: Its milk is delicious and chock-full of nutrients. However, if you drink too much, it could make your stomach hurt, so be careful.

277.name: Larvitar
277.dex_entry: Raised on nutrients it finds in the dirt, it eats roughly a mountain's worth of dirt before it becomes a pupa.

278.name: Pupitar
278.dex_entry: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

279.name: Tyranitar
279.dex_entry: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

279.2.name: Mega Tyranitar
279.2.dex_entry: The effects of Mega Evolution make it more ferocious than ever. It's unclear whether it can even hear its Trainer's orders.

280.name: Poochyena
280.dex_entry: Poochyena pursue their prey in packs. Once the prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.

281.name: Mightyena
281.dex_entry: They faithfully follow the orders of their leader. Prey targeted by Mightyena is never allowed to escape the outstanding teamwork of its pursuers.

282.name: Zigzagoon
282.dex_entry: It walks in zigzag fashion. It's good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.

282.2.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
282.2.dex_entry: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

283.name: Linoone
283.dex_entry: Linoone always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This Pokémon is very challenged by gently curving roads.

283.2.name: Galarian Linoone
283.2.dex_entry: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

284.name: Obstagoon
284.dex_entry: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

285.name: Wurmple
285.dex_entry: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

286.name: Silcoon
286.dex_entry: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

287.name: Beautifly
287.dex_entry: Beautifly's favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this Pokémon, just leave a potted flower by an open window. Beautifly is sure to come looking for pollen.

288.name: Cascoon
288.dex_entry: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

289.name: Dustox
289.dex_entry: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.

290.name: Lotad
290.dex_entry: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

291.name: Lombre
291.dex_entry: It sleeps on a bed of water-grass by day and becomes active at night. It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

292.name: Ludicolo
292.dex_entry: Upon hearing an upbeat and cheerful rhythm, the cells in Ludicolo's body become very energetic and active. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

293.name: Seedot
293.dex_entry: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

294.name: Nuzleaf
294.dex_entry: This Pokémon pulls out the leaf on its head and makes a flute with it. The sound of Nuzleaf's flute strikes fear and uncertainty in the hearts of people lost in a forest.

295.name: Shiftry
295.dex_entry: Shiftry is a mysterious Pokémon that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years. It creates terrific windstorms with the fans it holds.

296.name: Taillow
296.dex_entry: Taillow courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy Pokémon will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.

297.name: Swellow
297.dex_entry: Swellow is very conscientious about the upkeep of its glossy wings. Once two Swellow are gathered, they diligently take care of cleaning each other's wings.

298.name: Wingull
298.dex_entry: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea's edge.

299.name: Pelipper
299.dex_entry: Pelipper is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon and eggs inside its massive bill. This Pokémon builds its nest on steep cliffs facing the sea.

300.name: Ralts
300.dex_entry: Ralts has the ability to sense the emotions of people. If its Trainer is in a cheerful mood, this Pokémon grows cheerful and joyous in the same way.

301.name: Kirlia
301.dex_entry: It is said that a Kirlia that is exposed to the positive emotions of its Trainer grows beautiful. This Pokémon controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.

302.name: Gardevoir
302.dex_entry: Gardevoir has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its Trainer, this Pokémon is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.

302.2.name: Mega Gardevoir
302.2.dex_entry: When it opens the red plate on its chest and unleashes its heart, its strongest psychic power is released.

303.name: Gallade
303.dex_entry: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

303.2.name: Mega Gallade
303.2.dex_entry: It gets power from the bond it has with its Trainer. Mega Evolution has given it plates to slice its enemies and a cape to protect its body.

304.name: Surskit
304.dex_entry: From the tips of its feet, Surskit secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This Pokémon feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.

305.name: Masquerain
305.dex_entry: It intimidates enemies with the eye-like patterns on its antennae. Its four wings allow it to fly in any direction.

306.name: Shroomish
306.dex_entry: If Shroomish senses danger, it shakes its body and scatters spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over the body if inhaled.

307.name: Breloom
307.dex_entry: Breloom closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This Pokémon's fighting technique puts boxers to shame.

308.name: Slakoth
308.dex_entry: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.

309.name: Vigoroth
309.dex_entry: Vigoroth is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can't tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This Pokémon's stress level rises if it can't be moving constantly.

310.name: Slaking
310.dex_entry: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

311.name: Nincada
311.dex_entry: Nincada lives underground. It uses its sharp claws to carve the roots of trees and absorb moisture and nutrients. This Pokémon can't withstand bright sunlight so avoids it.

312.name: Ninjask
312.dex_entry: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

313.name: Shedinja
313.dex_entry: Shedinja's hard body doesn't move—not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this Pokémon will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.

314.name: Whismur
314.dex_entry: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

315.name: Loudred
315.dex_entry: Loudred shouts while stamping its feet. After it finishes shouting, this Pokémon becomes incapable of hearing anything for a while. This is considered to be a weak point.

316.name: Exploud
316.dex_entry: Exploud communicates its feelings to the others by emitting whistle-like sounds from the tubes on its body. In the past, people would use the loud voices of these Pokémon as a means of communication between distant cities.

317.name: Makuhita
317.dex_entry: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

318.name: Hariyama
318.dex_entry: Hariyama's thick body may appear fat, but it is actually a hunk of solid muscle. If this Pokémon bears down and tightens all its muscles, its body becomes as hard as a rock.

319.name: Nosepass
319.dex_entry: Nosepass's magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these Pokémon meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.

320.name: Probopass
320.dex_entry: Although it can control its units known as Mini-Noses, they sometimes get lost and don't come back.

321.name: Skitty
321.dex_entry: Skitty has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This Pokémon is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.

322.name: Delcatty
322.dex_entry: Delcatty prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this Pokémon eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.

323.name: Sableye
323.dex_entry: Materials from gems it has eaten float to the surface of its body and can form an infinite number of patterns among individuals.

323.2.name: Mega Sableye
323.2.dex_entry: It blocks any and all attacks with its giant-sized gemstone. However, the stone's a heavy burden, and it limits Mega Sableye's movements.

324.name: Mawile
324.dex_entry: Mawile's huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, Mawile chomps it with its gaping jaws.

324.2.name: Mega Mawile
324.2.dex_entry: It has an extremely vicious disposition. It grips prey in its two sets of jaws and tears them apart with raw power.

325.name: Aron
325.dex_entry: This Pokémon has a body of steel. To make its body, Aron feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.

326.name: Lairon
326.dex_entry: Lairon tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This Pokémon makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.

327.name: Aggron
327.dex_entry: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

327.2.name: Mega Aggron
327.2.dex_entry: Energy from Mega Evolution has turned the iron inside this Pokémon into steel armor that covers Mega Aggron's whole body.

328.name: Meditite
328.dex_entry: Meditite undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this Pokémon always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.

329.name: Medicham
329.dex_entry: Through yoga training, it has honed its sixth sense. This Pokémon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.

329.2.name: Mega Medicham
329.2.dex_entry: Thanks to Mega Evolution, its mental power is limitless. It conjures up arms imbued with malice to defeat its enemies.

330.name: Electrike
330.dex_entry: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. This Pokémon's whole body gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

331.name: Manectric
331.dex_entry: It discharges electricity from its mane. The Pokémon creates a thundercloud overhead from which to drop lightning bolts.

331.2.name: Mega Manectric
331.2.dex_entry: Mega Evolution fills its body with a tremendous amount of electricity, but it's too much for Manectric to fully control.

332.name: Plusle
332.dex_entry: When Plusle is cheering on its partner, it flashes with electric sparks from all over its body. If its partner loses, this Pokémon cries loudly.

333.name: Minun
333.dex_entry: Minun loves to cheer on its partner in battle. It gives off sparks from its body while it is doing so. If its partner is in trouble, this Pokémon gives off increasing amounts of sparks.

334.name: Volbeat
334.dex_entry: With the arrival of night, Volbeat emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This Pokémon is attracted by the sweet aroma of Illumise.

335.name: Illumise
335.dex_entry: Illumise attracts a swarm of Volbeat using a sweet fragrance. Once the Volbeat have gathered, this Pokémon leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.

336.name: Budew
336.dex_entry: This Pokémon is highly sensitive to temperature changes. When its bud starts to open, that means spring is right around the corner.

337.name: Roselia
337.dex_entry: It uses the different poisons in each hand separately when it attacks. The stronger its aroma, the healthier it is.

338.name: Roserade
338.dex_entry: Luring prey with a sweet scent, it uses poison whips on its arms to poison, bind, and finish off the prey. The poison in its right hand is quick acting, while the poison in its left hand is slow acting. Both are life threatening.

339.name: Gulpin
339.dex_entry: Virtually all of Gulpin's body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This Pokémon's stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.

340.name: Swalot
340.dex_entry: It swallows anything whole. It douses foes with the highly toxic fluid it secretes from its follicles.

341.name: Carvanha
341.dex_entry: They're such cowards that they won't hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!

342.name: Sharpedo
342.dex_entry: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.

342.2.name: Mega Sharpedo
342.2.dex_entry: The spines sprouting from its head are transformed fangs. If they're injured or broken off, the spines will regenerate countless times.

343.name: Wailmer
343.dex_entry: Wailmer spouts water from its nose. On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.

344.name: Wailord
344.dex_entry: When chasing prey, Wailord herds them by leaping out of the water and making a humongous splash. It is breathtaking to see this Pokémon leaping out of the sea with others in its pod.

345.name: Numel
345.dex_entry: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

346.name: Camerupt
346.dex_entry: The humps on Camerupt's back are formed by a transformation of its bones. They sometimes blast out molten magma. This Pokémon apparently erupts often when it is enraged.

346.2.name: Mega Camerupt
346.2.dex_entry: When this Pokémon's rage reaches a boiling point, the huge volcano in the hump on its back erupts violently, spewing molten lava.

347.name: Torkoal
347.dex_entry: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is in a tough situation.

348.name: Spoink
348.dex_entry: Spoink bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this Pokémon cannot afford to stop bouncing—if it stops, its heart will stop.

349.name: Grumpig
349.dex_entry: This Pokémon uses its black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It can control the minds of its foes through its mysterious dancing.

350.name: Spinda
350.dex_entry: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Their tottering steps hinder the aim of foes.

351.name: Trapinch
351.dex_entry: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

352.name: Vibrava
352.dex_entry: It generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously vibrating its wings. After making its prey faint, it dissolves the prey with its digestive juices.

353.name: Flygon
353.dex_entry: The sound of its wings flapping resembles singing. Those entranced by this sound get lured into a sandstorm and become Flygon's prey.

354.name: Cacnea
354.dex_entry: It prefers harsh environments, such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

355.name: Cacturne
355.dex_entry: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert's heat.

356.name: Swablu
356.dex_entry: For some reason, it likes to land on people's heads softly and act like it's a hat.

357.name: Altaria
357.dex_entry: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.

357.2.name: Mega Altaria
357.2.dex_entry: Its down is so soft, it seems as if a touch could melt it. But it's strong enough that just a few strands could be used to hoist a dump truck.

358.name: Zangoose
358.dex_entry: Every hair on its body stands up if it so much as smells a Seviper. Its sharp claws tear foes apart.

359.name: Seviper
359.dex_entry: It battles speedy Zangoose using its keenly bladed tail, which oozes an extremely powerful poison.

360.name: Lunatone
360.dex_entry: It becomes active on nights with a full moon, so it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

361.name: Solrock
361.dex_entry: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

362.name: Barboach
362.dex_entry: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

363.name: Whiscash
363.dex_entry: It claims a large swamp to itself. If a foe comes near it, it sets off tremors by thrashing around.

364.name: Corphish
364.dex_entry: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

365.name: Crawdaunt
365.dex_entry: Loving to battle, this Pokémon pinches all Pokémon that enter its territory with its pincers and throws them out.

366.name: Baltoy
366.dex_entry: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

367.name: Claydoy
367.dex_entry: The ancient people who made it apparently modeled it after something that descended from the sky. It fires beams from both arms.

368.name: Lileep
368.dex_entry: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Lileep once lived in warm seas that existed approximately 100,000,000 years ago.

369.name: Cradily
369.dex_entry: This carnivorous Pokémon lived in primordial seas. It catches prey in its eight tentacles and dissolves them with digestive fluid as it eats.

370.name: Anorith
370.dex_entry: This is one kind of primeval bug Pokémon. With eight wings, it could apparently swim a lot faster than you'd expect.

371.name: Armaldo
371.dex_entry: Armaldo is a Pokémon species that became extinct in prehistoric times. This Pokémon is said to have walked on its hind legs, which would have been more convenient for life on land.

372.name: Feebas
372.dex_entry: They are famous for their shabby appearance. Although Feebas are plentiful in number, they tend to cluster in specific places.

373.name: Milotic
373.dex_entry: They dwell at the bottoms of big lakes. Anyone who beholds the loveliness of these Pokémon is said to have their heart purified.

374.name: Castform
374.dex_entry: Although its form changes with the weather, that is apparently the result of a chemical reaction and not the result of its own free will.

374.2.name: Castform - Sunny
374.2.dex_entry: This is Castform's form when basking in fair weather. Its body is warm and toasty.

374.3.name: Castform - Rainy
374.3.dex_entry: This is the form Castform takes when soaked with rain. When its body is compressed, water will seep out as if from a sponge.

374.4.name: Castform - Snowy
374.4.dex_entry: This is Castform's form when caught in a hailstorm. Its cold skin is as smooth as ice.

374.5.name: Castform - Sandy
374.5.dex_entry: This is the form Castform takes when exposed to a sandstorm. Its body is covered in coarse sand particles and little rocks.

375.name: Kecleon
375.dex_entry: It changes color to blend in with its surroundings in order to sneak up on prey. It can't make its belly pattern disappear, however.

376.name: Shuppet
376.dex_entry: Shuppet grows by feeding on dark emotions, such as vengefulness and envy, in the hearts of people. It roams through cities in search of grudges that taint people.

377.name: Banette
377.dex_entry: It's a stuffed toy that was thrown away and became possessed, ever searching for the one who threw it away so it can exact its revenge.

377.2.name: Mega Banette
377.2.dex_entry: Mega Evolution increases its vindictiveness, and the cursing power that was held back by its zipper comes spilling out.

378.name: Duskull
378.dex_entry: In the dead of night, these Pokémon wander through towns in search of children, whose vital energy is a Duskull's favorite food.

379.name: Dusclops
379.dex_entry: This Pokémon will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out. Anyone who dares peer into Dusclops' body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

380.name: Dusknoir
380.dex_entry: Dusknoir comes and goes between this world and the afterlife. It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

381.name: Tropius
381.dex_entry: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

382.name: Chingling
382.dex_entry: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.

383.name: Chimecho
383.dex_entry: Chimecho create air vibrations with their cries to send foes flying. They have seven different types of cries they use to converse with one another.

383.2.name: Mega Chimecho
383.2.dex_entry: It vibrates its entire body to attack in all directions using sound waves. Any who hear the vibrations get so confused, they forget who they are.

384.name: Absol
384.dex_entry: Although it's said to bring disaster, in actuality, this Pokémon possesses a calm disposition and warns people of any crises that loom.

384.2.name: Mega Absol
384.2.dex_entry: As the energy of Mega Evolution fills it, its fur bristles. What you see on its back are not true wings, and this Pokémon isn't able to fly.

384.3.name: Mega Absol Z
384.3.dex_entry: Using fur that it has made into sharp, clawlike shapes, it cuts down foes with a single blow. This is an act of kindness to keep them from suffering.

385.name: Snorunt
385.dex_entry: Snorunt survives by eating only snow and ice. Old folklore claims that a house visited by this Pokémon is sure to prosper for many generations to come.

386.name: Glalie
386.dex_entry: Glalie has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This Pokémon has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.

386.2.name: Mega Glalie
386.2.dex_entry: It envelops prey in its mouth, freezing them instantly. But its jaw is dislocated, so it's unable to eat them.

387.name: Froslass
387.dex_entry: It freezes hikers who have come to climb snowy mountains and carries them back to its home. It only goes after men it thinks are handsome.

387.2.name: Mega Froslass
387.2.dex_entry: This Pokémon can use eerie cold air imbued with ghost energy to freeze even insubstantial things, such as flames or the wind.

388.name: Spheal
388.dex_entry: This Pokémon's body is covered in blubber and impressively round. It's faster for Spheal to roll around than walk.

389.name: Sealeo
389.dex_entry: Sealeo often balances and rolls things on the tip of its nose. While the Pokémon is rolling something, it checks the object's aroma and texture to determine whether it likes the object or not.

390.name: Walrein
390.dex_entry: Walrein's two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing 10 tons with one blow. This Pokémon's thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.

391.name: Clamperl
391.dex_entry: Despite its appearance, it's carnivorous. It clamps down on its prey with both sides of its shell and doesn't let go until they stop moving. Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent pearl.

392.name: Huntail
392.dex_entry: Huntail's tail is shaped like a fish. It uses the tail to attract prey, then swallows the prey whole with its large, gaping mouth. This Pokémon swims by wiggling its slender body like a snake.

393.name: Gorebyss
393.dex_entry: Although Gorebyss is the very picture of elegance and beauty while swimming, it is also cruel. When it spots prey, this Pokémon inserts its thin mouth into the prey's body and drains the prey of its body fluids.

394.name: Relicanth
394.dex_entry: This rare Pokémon was discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

395.name: Luvdisc
395.dex_entry: Loving couples have a soft spot for this Pokémon, so honeymoon hotels often release this Pokémon into their pools.

396.name: Bagon
396.dex_entry: Bagon jumps off cliffs every day, trying to grow stronger so that someday it will be able to fly.

397.name: Shelgon
397.dex_entry: This Pokémon has covered its body in a hard shell that has the same composition as bone. Shelgon stores energy for evolution.

398.name: Salamence
398.dex_entry: While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.

398.2.name: Mega Salamence
398.2.dex_entry: Anyone standing in its path gets sliced right in two, while this Pokémon continues its flight without interruption.

399.name: Beldum
399.dex_entry: They communicate with one another by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

400.name: Metang
400.dex_entry: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

401.name: Metagross
401.dex_entry: A linkage of two Metang, this Pokémon can perform any calculation in a flash by utilizing parallel processing in its four brains.

401.2.name: Mega Metagross
401.2.dex_entry: Its intellect surpasses its previous level, resulting in battles so cruel, they'll make you want to cover your eyes.

402.name: Starly
402.dex_entry: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

403.name: Staravia
403.dex_entry: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

404.name: Staraptor
404.dex_entry: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

404.2.name: Mega Staraptor
404.2.dex_entry: Mega Staraptor is a top-class flier. It can easily soar through the sky while gripping a Steelix that weighs more than 880 lbs.

405.name: Bidoof
405.dex_entry: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

406.name: Bibarel
406.dex_entry: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

407.name: Kricketot
407.dex_entry: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

408.name: Kricketune
408.dex_entry: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.

409.name: Shinx
409.dex_entry: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it's in trouble.

410.name: Luxio
410.dex_entry: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

411.name: Luxray
411.dex_entry: Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.

412.name: Cranidos
412.dex_entry: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with headbutts.

413.name: Rampardos
413.dex_entry: Its skull is as hard as iron. It is a brute that tears down jungle trees while catching prey.

414.name: Shieldon
414.dex_entry: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it has no particular need to battle with others and can spend its time feeding on grass and berries.

415.name: Bastiodon
