415.dex_entry: While it can guard against any sort of attack from the front, it is left without recourse when attacked from behind.

416.name: Burmy - Plant Cloak
416.dex_entry: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.

416.2.name: Burmy - Sandy Cloak
416.2.dex_entry: It creates a cloak by weaving together sand, mud, and silk it has spat out. This earthen cloak is ruined by wind and rain, so the Pokémon hides away in caves and other such places.

416.3.name: Burmy - Trash Cloak
416.3.dex_entry: When confronted by a lack of other materials, Burmy will create its cloak using dust and refuse. The cloak seems to be more comfortable than one would think.

417.name: Wormadam - Plant Cloak
417.dex_entry: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

417.2.name: Wormadam - Sandy Cloak
417.2.dex_entry: Its earthen skin is reasonably hard—it has no problem repelling a Starly's pecking, at least.

417.3.name: Wormadam - Trash Cloak
417.3.dex_entry: Its body, composed of refuse, blends in to the scenery so much as to be inconspicuous. This seems to be the perfect way for the Pokémon to evade the detection of predators.

418.name: Mothim
418.dex_entry: While it loves floral honey, it won't gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from Combee.

419.name: Combee
419.dex_entry: The trio is together from birth. It ceaselessly gathers nectar from sunrise to sundown, all for the sake of Vespiquen and the swarm.

420.name: Vespiquen
420.dex_entry: When it is in danger, grubs from its six-cell honeycomb strike back. There is only one in a colony.

421.name: Male Vespiquen
421.dex_entry: This Pokémon shows an absolute dedication at protecting the colony from invaders. It becomes very aggressive whenever its queen or hive members are threatened.

422.name: Tank Bee
422.dex_entry: Tank Bee's robust constitution is the result of a diet rich in royal jelly. It serves equally well as a carrier, a mount or a self-propelled battering ram.

423.name: Pachirisu
423.dex_entry: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

424.name: Buizel
424.dex_entry: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

425.name: Floatzel
425.dex_entry: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and help fishers carry what they caught.

426.name: Cherubi
426.dex_entry: Once the fruit growing alongside the main body is large and plump, Cherubi will use the nutrients within to evolve. The fruit then detaches, becoming nourishment for other creatures.

427.name: Cherrim
427.dex_entry: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.

428.name: Shellos - West Sea
428.dex_entry: Found in abundance on seashores bordering warm waters. Shellos are unexpectedly friendly and will crawl toward any person they see. Take care not to get coated in mucus!

428.2.name: Shellos - East Sea
428.2.dex_entry: Found in abundance on seashores bordering cold waters. When pressed upon, the Pokémon will secrete from its body's surface a purple fluid that will stain one's clothes.

429.name: Gastrodon - West Sea
429.dex_entry: It has strong regenerative capabilities. Even if parts of it are bitten off by fish Pokémon, it will return to normal within a few hours.

429.2.name: Gastrodon - East Sea
429.2.dex_entry: When it's attacked, it gushes a purple liquid that's not poisonous but makes Gastrodon's meat bitter and inedible.

430.name: Drifloon
430.dex_entry: Stories go that it grabs the hands of small children and drags them away to the afterlife. It dislikes heavy children.

431.name: Drifblim
431.dex_entry: The raw material for the gas inside its body is souls. When its body starts to deflate, it's thought to carry away people and Pokémon.

432.name: Buneary
432.dex_entry: One of Buneary's ears is always rolled up. It can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

433.name: Lopunny
433.dex_entry: It's notably wary and has a dislike of fighting, but at the same time, it can deliver powerful kicks with its lithe legs.

433.2.name: Mega Lopunny
433.2.dex_entry: It swings its ears like whips and strikes its enemies with them. It has an intensely combative disposition.

434.name: Glameow
434.dex_entry: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

435.name: Purugly
435.dex_entry: It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger. If it locks eyes, it will glare ceaselessly.

436.name: Stunky
436.dex_entry: If it lifts its tail and points its rear at you, beware. It's about to spray you with a fluid stinky enough to make you faint.

437.name: Skuntank
437.dex_entry: In its belly, it reserves stinky fluid that it shoots from its tail during battle. As this Pokémon's diet varies, so does the stench of its fluid.

438.name: Bronzor
438.dex_entry: They are found in ancient tombs. The patterns on their backs are said to be imbued with mysterious power.

439.name: Bronzong
439.dex_entry: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

440.name: Chatot
440.dex_entry: Its tongue is just like a human's. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

441.name: Spiritomb
441.dex_entry: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

442.name: Gible
442.dex_entry: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.

443.name: Gabite
443.dex_entry: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

444.name: Garchomp
444.dex_entry: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

444.2.name: Mega Garchomp
444.2.dex_entry: Its arms and wings melted into something like scythes. Mad with rage, it rampages on and on.

444.3.name: Mega Garchomp Z
444.3.dex_entry: Garchomp has gained a new Mega-Evolved form. It flies around foes at Mach speed and cuts them to shreds with its sinister wing claws.

445.name: Riolu
445.dex_entry: It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.

446.name: Lucario
446.dex_entry: Lucario reads its opponent's feelings with its aura waves. It finds out things it would rather not know, so it gets stressed out easily.

446.2.name: Mega Lucario
446.2.dex_entry: Its aura has expanded due to Mega Evolution. Governed only by its combative instincts, it strikes enemies without mercy.

446.3.name: Mega Lucario Z
446.3.dex_entry: By completely cloaking itself in its aura, Mega Lucario Z can parry all manner of attacks, battling as if it were gracefully dancing.

447.name: Hippopotas
447.dex_entry: It moves through the sands with its mouth open, swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of the sand by spouting it from its nose.

448.name: Hippowdon
448.dex_entry: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

449.name: Skorupi
449.dex_entry: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

450.name: Drapion
450.dex_entry: Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This Pokémon prefers to use physical force instead, going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.

451.name: Croagunk
451.dex_entry: Once diluted, its poison becomes medicinal. This Pokémon came into popularity after a pharmaceutical company chose it as a mascot.

452.name: Toxicroak
452.dex_entry: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

453.name: Carnivine
453.dex_entry: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

454.name: Finneon
454.dex_entry: When night falls, their pink patterns begin to shine. They're popular with divers, so there are resorts that feed them to keep them close.

455.name: Lumineon
455.dex_entry: They traverse the deep waters as if crawling over the seafloor. The fantastic lights of its fins shine like stars in the night sky.

456.name: Snover
456.dex_entry: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring. Once a year, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.

457.name: Abomasnow
457.dex_entry: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

457.2.name: Mega Abomasnow
457.2.dex_entry: The buds on its back have sprouted into impressive icicles that can whip up massive blizzards of -22 degrees Fahrenheit.

458.name: Rotom
458.dex_entry: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

458.2.name: Rotom - Heat
458.2.dex_entry: This Rotom has possessed a convection microwave oven. It will gleefully burn your favorite outfit.

458.3.name: Rotom - Wash
458.3.dex_entry: This Rotom that has entered a washing machine enjoys coming up with water-based pranks. Be careful with it if you don't want your room flooded.

458.4.name: Rotom - Frost
458.4.dex_entry: This Rotom has entered a refrigerator. You may find it's turned the bath you just filled to solid ice!

458.5.name: Rotom - Fan
458.5.dex_entry: This Rotom has taken over an electric fan. It will happily blow away any important documents it can find.

458.6.name: Rotom - Mow
458.6.dex_entry: This is Rotom after it's seized control of a lawn mower. As it mows down grass, it scatters the clippings everywhere.

459.name: Patrat
459.dex_entry: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

460.name: Watchog
460.dex_entry: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

461.name: Lillipup
461.dex_entry: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it's also smart enough to check its foe's strength and avoid battle.

462.name: Herdier
462.dex_entry: This Pokémon obeys its master's orders faithfully. However, it refuses to listen to anything said by a person it doesn't respect.

463.name: Stoutland
463.dex_entry: Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable that a person would be fine even overnight on a wintry mountain. A long time ago in cold regions, every household kept a Stoutland.

464.name: Purrloin
464.dex_entry: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

465.name: Liepard
465.dex_entry: Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.

466.name: Pansage
466.dex_entry: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

467.name: Simisage
467.dex_entry: Ill-tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaves growing on its head are very bitter.

468.name: Pansear
468.dex_entry: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

469.name: Simisear
469.dex_entry: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

470.name: Panpour
470.dex_entry: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

471.name: Simipour
471.dex_entry: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

472.name: Munna
472.dex_entry: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it's eating a good dream, and black when it's eating a nightmare.

473.name: Musharna
473.dex_entry: The mist from its forehead takes the shape of things that appeared in dreams Musharna has eaten, giving those dreams physical form.

474.name: Pidove
474.dex_entry: It's forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.

475.name: Tranquill
475.dex_entry: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

476.name: Unfezant
476.dex_entry: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.

477.name: Blitzle
477.dex_entry: This Pokémon prefers places with lots of lightning strikes. It catches lightning with its mane and stores the electricity within its body.

478.name: Zebstrika
478.dex_entry: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

479.name: Roggenrola
479.dex_entry: The hexagonal hole is its ear. Deep in that ear is an energy core, so if you stick your hand in there, Roggenrola will be very angry!

480.name: Boldore
480.dex_entry: Its orange crystal is a mass of energy. Just one crystal fragment would provide enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks.

481.name: Gigalith
481.dex_entry: The blasts of energy it makes from sunbeams have terrifying power. However, it's not able to fire its blasts at night or on rainy days.

482.name: Woobat
482.dex_entry: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it's evidence that Woobat live there.

483.name: Swoobat
483.dex_entry: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

484.name: Drilbur
484.dex_entry: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

485.name: Excadrill
485.dex_entry: Its drill, which has evolved into steel, is strong enough to bore through iron plates. This Pokémon is a great help in tunnel construction.

485.2.name: Mega Excadrill
485.2.dex_entry: Its drill, which has evolved into steel, is strong enough to bore through iron plates. This Pokémon is a great help in tunnel construction.

486.name: Audino
486.dex_entry: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to check their emotions and physical health.

486.2.name: Mega Audino
486.2.dex_entry: Anyone who touches the secondary feelers that have sprouted from the base of its throat will fall into a deep sleep.

487.name: Timburr
487.dex_entry: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

488.name: Gurdurr
488.dex_entry: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

489.name: Conkeldurr
489.dex_entry: Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more durable than normal concrete, even when the compositions of the two materials are the same.

490.name: Tympole
490.dex_entry: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

491.name: Palpitoad
491.dex_entry: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

492.name: Seismitoad
492.dex_entry: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

493.name: Throh
493.dex_entry: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

494.name: Sawk
494.dex_entry: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

495.name: Sewaddle
495.dex_entry: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

496.name: Swadloon
496.dex_entry: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

497.name: Leavanny
497.dex_entry: It fashions clothing from woven leaves. Though gentle in disposition, it will show no mercy to foes who target young Pokémon.

498.name: Venipede
498.dex_entry: Its bite injects a venom potent enough to paralyze even the large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

499.name: Whirlipede
499.dex_entry: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

500.name: Scolipede
500.dex_entry: Scolipede latches on to its prey with the claws on its neck before slamming them into the ground and jabbing them with its claw's toxic spikes.

500.2.name: Mega Scolipede
500.2.dex_entry: Its deadly venom gives off a faint glow. The venom affects Scolipede's mind, honing its viciousness.

501.name: Cottonee
501.dex_entry: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.

502.name: Whimsicott
502.dex_entry: It rides on the wind and slips into people's homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton- filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

503.name: Petilil
503.dex_entry: Some say if you dry the leaves on its head, boil them down, and drink the infusion, your vigor will return, so Petilil is popular with the elderly.

504.name: Lilligant
504.dex_entry: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

504.2.name: Hisuian Lilligant
504.2.dex_entry: It is suspected that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

505.name: Basculin - Red Striped
505.dex_entry: Its temperament is vicious and aggressive. This Pokémon is also full of vitality and can multiply rapidly before anyone notices.

505.2.name: Basculin - Blue Striped
505.2.dex_entry: These Pokémon form schools with others of the same color. The greatest foe of a school of blue Basculin is a school of red Basculin.

505.3.name: Basculin - White Striped
505.3.dex_entry: They live in frigid seas, forming schools and sharing food among themselves. When the time comes, they return to the river they were born in.

506.name: Basculegion - Male
506.dex_entry: This Pokémon is cloaked in the souls of its comrades who perished during a punishing journey to the river of their birth.

506.2.name: Basculegion - Female
506.2.dex_entry: It can afflict a target with terrifying illusions that are under its control. The deeper the sadness in its friends' souls, the paler Basculegion becomes.

507.name: Sandile
507.dex_entry: It moves below the sand's surface, exposing only its nose and eyes. A black membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

508.name: Krokorok
508.dex_entry: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

509.name: Krookodile
509.dex_entry: While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.

510.name: Darumaka
510.dex_entry: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.

510.2.name: Galarian Darumaka
510.2.dex_entry: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

511.name: Darmanitan
511.dex_entry: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.

511.2.name: Darmanitan - Zen Mode
511.2.dex_entry: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.

511.3.name: Galarian Darmanitan
511.3.dex_entry: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

511.4.name: Galarian Darmanitan - Zen Mode
511.4.dex_entry: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. It won't stop spewing flames until its rage has settled, even if its body starts to melt.

512.name: Maractus
512.dex_entry: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.

513.name: Dwebble
513.dex_entry: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

514.name: Crustle
514.dex_entry: This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry climates. It won't come out of its boulder on rainy days.

515.name: Scraggy
515.dex_entry: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

516.name: Scrafty
516.dex_entry: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

516.2.name: Mega Scrafty
516.2.dex_entry: Mega Evolution has caused Scrafty's shed skin to turn white, growing tough and supple. Of course, this Pokémon is still as feisty as ever.

517.name: Sigilyph
517.dex_entry: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

518.name: Yamask
518.dex_entry: Each Yamask carries a mask representing the face it had when it was still human. Sometimes it gazes at the mask and weeps.

518.2.name: Galarian Yamask
518.2.dex_entry: A cursed clay slab and a departed spirit have become bound together. This Pokémon swings its slab around with malicious intent.

519.name: Cofagrigus
519.dex_entry: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

520.name: Runerigus
520.dex_entry: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

521.name: Tirtouga
521.dex_entry: This Pokémon inhabited ancient seas. Although it can only crawl, it still comes up onto land in search of prey.

522.name: Carracosta
522.dex_entry: Carracosta eats every last bit of the prey it catches, even the shells and bones, to further strengthen its sturdy shell.

523.name: Archen
523.dex_entry: It is the ancestor of all bird Pokémon. Archen itself could not actually fly but moved by hopping from treetop to treetop.

524.name: Archeops
524.dex_entry: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, the muscles it uses to flap its wings are still weak, so it needs a long runway in order to take off.

525.name: Trubbish
525.dex_entry: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

526.name: Garbodor
526.dex_entry: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

527.name: Zorua
527.dex_entry: Zorua sometimes transforms into a person and goes into cities to search for food. When Zorua does this, it usually takes on the form of a child.

527.2.name: Hisuian Zorua
527.2.dex_entry: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

528.name: Zoroark
528.dex_entry: This Pokémon cares deeply about others of its kind, and it will conjure terrifying illusions to keep its den and pack safe.

528.2.name: Hisuian Zoroark
528.2.dex_entry: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

529.name: Minccino
529.dex_entry: A clean freak that will not allow even the slightest mess, it uses its tail like a mop to thoroughly clean any and all filth.

530.name: Cinccino
530.dex_entry: The oil that seeps from its body is really smooth. For people troubled by bad skin, this oil is an effective treatment.

531.name: Gothita
531.dex_entry: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

532.name: Gothorita
532.dex_entry: This Pokémon will hypnotize children to put them to sleep before carrying them away. Be wary of nights when the starlight is bright.

533.name: Gothitelle
533.dex_entry: It gazes at the stars to predict the future. It acts somewhat detached because it has seen the end of all existence.

534.name: Solosis
534.dex_entry: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.

535.name: Duosion
535.dex_entry: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

536.name: Reuniclus
536.dex_entry: It's said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

537.name: Ducklett
537.dex_entry: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

538.name: Swanna
538.dex_entry: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

539.name: Vanillite
539.dex_entry: It feels pleasantly cool when embraced. This Pokémon is treasured by households in warm regions.

540.name: Vanillish
540.dex_entry: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

541.name: Vanilluxe
541.dex_entry: It blasts blizzards from its two mouths. It can create snow anywhere, so it gets a lot of love from skiers and snowboarders.

542.name: Deerling
542.dex_entry: Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.

543.name: Sawsbuck
543.dex_entry: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

544.name: Emolga
544.dex_entry: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can't fly properly.

545.name: Karrablast
545.dex_entry: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

546.name: Escavalier
546.dex_entry: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

547.name: Foongus
547.dex_entry: It lures targets in with its Poké Ball-like pattern and sprays poison spores at them. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

548.name: Amoonguss
548.dex_entry: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren't washed off quickly, they'll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.

549.name: Frillish
549.dex_entry: It wraps its veillike arms and legs around prey swimming by and drags them down to the depths of the ocean.

550.name: Jellicent
550.dex_entry: Its body is mostly seawater. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

551.name: Alomomola
551.dex_entry: It gently holds injured and weak Pokémon in its fins. Its special membrane heals their wounds.

552.name: Joltik
552.dex_entry: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It's soaking up static electricity because it can't produce a charge on its own.

553.name: Galvantula
553.dex_entry: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.

554.name: Ferroseed
554.dex_entry: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

555.name: Ferrothorn
555.dex_entry: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

556.name: Klink
556.dex_entry: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

557.name: Klang
557.dex_entry: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

558.name: Klinklang
558.dex_entry: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

559.name: Tynamo
559.dex_entry: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

560.name: Eelektrik
560.dex_entry: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes them with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

561.name: Eelektross
561.dex_entry: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

561.2.name: Mega Eelektross
561.2.dex_entry: It now generates 10 times the electricity it did before Mega Evolving. It discharges this electricity from its false Eelektrik, which are made of mucus.

562.name: Elgyem
562.dex_entry: It controls tremendous psychic power. Most reports of alien sightings are actually just people mistaking Elgyem for an alien.

563.name: Beheeyem
563.dex_entry: It has strong psychic powers. Using its fingers that flash three different colors, it controls its opponents and rewrites their memories.

564.name: Litwick
564.dex_entry: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

565.name: Lampent
565.dex_entry: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

566.name: Chandelure
566.dex_entry: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

566.2.name: Mega Chandelure
566.2.dex_entry: One of its eyes is a window linking our world with the afterlife. This Pokémon draws in hatred and converts it into power.

567.name: Axew
567.dex_entry: They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn't a concern.

568.name: Fraxure
568.dex_entry: A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

569.name: Haxorus
569.dex_entry: While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.

570.name: Cubchoo
570.dex_entry: Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

571.name: Beartic
571.dex_entry: It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.

572.name: Cryogonal
572.dex_entry: Cryogonal uses its chains of ice to constrict its opponents and then flash-freezes them where they stand.

573.name: Shelmet
573.dex_entry: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

574.name: Accelgor
574.dex_entry: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

575.name: Stunfisk
575.dex_entry: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

575.2.name: Galarian Stunfisk
575.2.dex_entry: Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as it lies in wait in the mud. When prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps its jagged steel fins down on them.

576.name: Mienfoo
576.dex_entry: They seclude themselves in the mountains and devote themselves to training. The form of their kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.

577.name: Mienshao
577.dex_entry: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.

578.name: Druddigon
578.dex_entry: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

579.name: Golett
579.dex_entry: Ancient people apparently fashioned Golett out of clay to do their labor for them. What powers these Pokémon remains unclear.

580.name: Golurk
580.dex_entry: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

580.2.name: Mega Golurk
580.2.dex_entry: The energy within Golurk has been stimulated by Mega Evolution. The Pokémon could explode at any moment.

581.name: Pawniard
581.dex_entry: After shredding its prey, it sharpens its blades on a stone by the river. Each Pawniard has its own favorite sharpening stone.

582.name: Bisharp
582.dex_entry: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

583.name: Kingambit
583.dex_entry: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it's not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

584.name: Bouffalant
584.dex_entry: These Pokémon can crush a car with no more than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on their heads hold higher positions within the herd.

585.name: Rufflet
585.dex_entry: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it's a carnivore at heart.

586.name: Braviary
586.dex_entry: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.

586.2.name: Hisuian Braviary
586.2.dex_entry: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

587.name: Vullaby
587.dex_entry: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

588.name: Mandibuzz
588.dex_entry: Watching from the sky, they attack weakened prey on the ground. They have a habit of decorating themselves with bones.

589.name: Heatmor
589.dex_entry: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

590.name: Durant
590.dex_entry: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

591.name: Deino
591.dex_entry: It can't see, so its first approach to examining things is to bite them. You will be covered in wounds until a Deino warms up to you.

592.name: Zweilous
592.dex_entry: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

593.name: Hydreigon
593.dex_entry: Only the central head has a brain. It is very intelligent, but it thinks only of destruction.

594.name: Larvesta
594.dex_entry: In ancient times, Larvesta was worshiped as the emissary of the sun. However, it was also viewed as a burden since it often caused forest fires.

595.name: Volcarona
595.dex_entry: This Pokémon scatters burning scales. Most of the danger of these scales is not in their heat—it's in the way they rob the surrounding air of oxygen.

596.name: Bunnelby
596.dex_entry: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through without rest.

597.name: Diggersby
597.dex_entry: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

598.name: Fletchling
598.dex_entry: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

599.name: Fletchinder
599.dex_entry: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

600.name: Talonflame
600.dex_entry: When it gets excited, it vents sparks from the gaps between its feathers. These unburnable feathers are used as a fireproof material.

601.name: Scatterbug
601.dex_entry: Any poison this Pokémon takes in is converted into a black powder and secreted. That's why Scatterbug can eat poisonous leaves and roots.

602.name: Spewpa
602.dex_entry: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

603.name: Vivillon
603.dex_entry: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.

604.name: Litleo
604.dex_entry: When Litleo are young, female Pyroar will teach them how to hunt. Once the Litleo mature, they will leave the pride and set out on their own.

605.name: Pyroar
605.dex_entry: The females of a pride work together to bring down prey. It's thanks to them that their pride doesn't starve.

605.2.name: Mega Pyroar
605.2.dex_entry: This Pokémon spews flames hotter than 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. It swings around its grand, blazing mane as it protects its allies.

606.name: Flabébé
606.dex_entry: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

607.name: Floette
607.dex_entry: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

607.2.name: Floette - Eternal Flower
607.2.dex_entry: The flower it's holding can no longer be found blooming anywhere. It's also thought to contain terrifying power.

607.3.name: Mega Floette
607.3.dex_entry: The Eternal Flower has absorbed all the energy from Mega Evolution. The flower now attacks enemies on its own.

608.name: Florges
608.dex_entry: It controls the flowers it grows. The petal blizzards that Florges triggers are overwhelming in their beauty and power.

609.name: Skiddo
609.dex_entry: As long as it has sunlight and water, Skiddo can make energy with the leaves on its body, allowing it to live on rocky mountains barren of food.

610.name: Gogoat
610.dex_entry: It can sense the feelings of others by touching them with its horns. This species has assisted people with their work since 5,000 years ago.

611.name: Pancham
611.dex_entry: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can't help grinning if anyone pats its head.

612.name: Pangoro
612.dex_entry: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent's movements. It's eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.

613.name: Furfrou
613.dex_entry: There was an era when aristocrats would compete to see who could trim their Furfrou's fur into the most exquisite style.

614.name: Espurr
614.dex_entry: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

615.name: Meowstic - Male
615.dex_entry: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

615.2.name: Meowstic - Female
615.2.dex_entry: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

615.3.name: Mega Meowstic
615.3.dex_entry: Mega Meowstic can use its psychic power to compress or expand anything. It overwhelms foes by contorting space itself.

616.name: Honedge
616.dex_entry: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

617.name: Doublade
617.dex_entry: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords that cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

618.name: Aegislash - Shield
618.dex_entry: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

618.2.name: Aegislash - Blade
618.2.dex_entry: This stance is dedicated to offense. It can cleave any opponent with the strength and weight of its steel blade.

619.name: Spritzee
619.dex_entry: A scent pouch within this Pokémon's body allows it to create various scents. A change in its diet will alter the fragrance it produces.

620.name: Aromatisse
620.dex_entry: The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent's will to fight.

621.name: Swirlix
621.dex_entry: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix's fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

622.name: Slurpuff
622.dex_entry: Its sense of smell is 100 million times better than a human's, so even the faintest scent tells it about everything in the area. It's like it can see with its nose!

623.name: Inkay
623.dex_entry: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

624.name: Malamar
624.dex_entry: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar's control.

624.2.name: Mega Malamar
624.2.dex_entry: It uses its colorful lights to overwrite the personalities and memories of others—and to control them.

625.name: Binacle
625.dex_entry: If the two don't work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won't survive.

626.name: Barbaracle
626.dex_entry: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

626.2.name: Mega Barbaracle
626.2.dex_entry: It uses its many arms to toy with its opponents. This keeps the head extremely busy.

627.name: Skrelp
627.dex_entry: Skrelp evades its enemies by hiding amid drifting seaweed. It eats rotten seaweed to create its poison.

628.name: Dragalge
628.dex_entry: It blends in with seaweed to ambush its prey and then takes them down with a poisonous liquid strong enough to melt metal.

628.2.name: Mega Dragalge
628.2.dex_entry: It spits a liquid that causes the regenerative power of cells to run wild. The liquid is deadly poison to everything other than itself.

629.name: Clauncher
629.dex_entry: Clauncher's claws will regrow if they fall off. The meat inside the claws is edible, but it has a distinct flavor that doesn't appeal to all tastes.

630.name: Clawitzer
630.dex_entry: Clawitzer's right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer's cannon arm can sink a tanker.

631.name: Helioptile
631.dex_entry: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

632.name: Heliolisk
632.dex_entry: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

633.name: Tyrunt
633.dex_entry: This is an ancient Pokémon, revived in modern times. It has a violent disposition, and it'll tear apart anything it gets between its hefty jaws.

634.name: Tyrantrum
634.dex_entry: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

635.name: Amaura
635.dex_entry: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.

636.name: Aurorus
636.dex_entry: Aurorus was restored from a fossil. It's said that when this Pokémon howls, auroras appear in the night sky.

637.name: Hawlucha
637.dex_entry: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

637.2.name: Mega Hawlucha
637.2.dex_entry: Mega Evolution has pumped up all its muscles. Hawlucha flexes to show off its strength.

638.name: Dedenne
638.dex_entry: It sneaks into people's homes and steals electricity from their outlets. When your electric bill seems off, it's the handiwork of this rascal.

639.name: Carbink
639.dex_entry: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it defends itself by firing beams from the jewel part of its body.

640.name: Goomy
640.dex_entry: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

641.name: Sliggoo
641.dex_entry: It has trouble drawing a line between friends and food. It will calmly try to melt and eat even those it gets along well with.

641.2.name: Hisuian Sliggoo
641.2.dex_entry: The iron in Sliggoo's drinking water turned its shell metallic. The Pokémon doesn't come out of its shell on sunny days.

642.name: Goodra
642.dex_entry: It's very friendly toward people. If you grow close to it, Goodra will hug you with its sticky, slime-covered body. Don't get mad.

642.2.name: Hisuian Goodra
642.2.dex_entry: If anything bad happens to it, Goodra retreats into its shell and bounces around like a rubber ball, knocking down trees and boring into mountains.

643.name: Klefki
643.dex_entry: This Pokémon is constantly collecting keys. Entrust a Klefki with important keys, and the Pokémon will protect them no matter what.

644.name: Phantump
644.dex_entry: This Pokémon came to be when the spirit of a deceased child possessed a tree stump. It now wanders the forest searching for friends.

645.name: Trevenant
645.dex_entry: This Pokémon is said to devour anyone daring to ravage the forest. To the creatures dwelling in the forest, it offers great kindness.

646.name: Pumpkaboo
646.dex_entry: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

647.name: Gourgeist
647.dex_entry: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.

648.name: Bergmite
648.dex_entry: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. If the ice breaks, this Pokémon uses cold air to quickly create new ice.

649.name: Avalugg
649.dex_entry: This Pokémon uses its massive icy body to flatten anything that gets in its way. When it's floating out on the ocean, it looks exactly like drift ice.

649.2.name: Hisuian Avalugg
649.2.dex_entry: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

650.name: Noibat
650.dex_entry: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

651.name: Noivern
651.dex_entry: In the dark, even Hydreigon are terrified of this Pokémon. But in the light, Noivern is the one that avoids battle.

652.name: Pikipek
652.dex_entry: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.

653.name: Trumbeak
653.dex_entry: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.

654.name: Toucannon
654.dex_entry: Pairs of Toucannon are considered symbols of companionship, as these Pokémon will raise the temperature of their beaks to warm each other.

655.name: Yungoos
655.dex_entry: It spends its waking hours searching for food. When Yungoos is hungry, its ferocity gains a certain edge.

656.name: Gumshoos
656.dex_entry: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it's always snoozing by nightfall.

657.name: Grubbin
657.dex_entry: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.

658.name: Charjabug
658.dex_entry: It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you'll get a shock!

659.name: Vikavolt
659.dex_entry: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.

660.name: Crabrawler
660.dex_entry: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

661.name: Crabominable
661.dex_entry: It punches things without pausing to think. There are even records of Crabominable forcing back an avalanche with a flurry of punches.

661.2.name: Mega Crabominable
661.2.dex_entry: It can pulverize reinforced concrete with a light swing of one of its fists, each of which is covered in a thick layer of ice.

662.name: Oricorio - Baile
662.dex_entry: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

662.2.name: Oricorio - Pom-Pom
662.2.dex_entry: It creates an electric charge by rubbing its feathers together. It dances over to its enemies and delivers shocking electrical punches.

662.3.name: Oricorio - Pa'u
662.3.dex_entry: This Oricorio relaxes by swaying gently. This increases its psychic energy, which it then fires at its enemies.

662.4.name: Oricorio - Sensu
662.4.dex_entry: It summons the dead with its dreamy dancing. From their malice, it draws power with which to curse its enemies.

663.name: Cutiefly
663.dex_entry: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

664.name: Ribombee
664.dex_entry: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

665.name: Rockruff
665.dex_entry: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

666.name: Lycanroc - Midday
666.dex_entry: It has a calm and collected demeanor. It swiftly closes in on its prey, then slices them with the rocks in its mane.

666.2.name: Lycanroc - Midnight
666.2.dex_entry: This form of Lycanroc is reckless. It charges headlong at its opponents, attacking without any care about what injuries it might receive.

666.3.name: Lycanroc - Dusk
666.3.dex_entry: These Pokémon have both calm and ferocious qualities. Their temperamental nature makes them a difficult species to raise.

667.name: Wishiwashi
667.dex_entry: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

667.2.name: Wishiwashi - School
667.2.dex_entry: When facing tough opponents, they get into formation. But if they get wounded in battle, they'll scatter and become solitary again.

668.name: Mareanie
668.dex_entry: It's found crawling on beaches and seafloors. The coral that grows on Corsola's head is as good as a five-star banquet to this Pokémon.

669.name: Toxapex
669.dex_entry: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.

670.name: Mudbray
670.dex_entry: This Pokémon covers itself in mud that it has regurgitated. The mud won't dry out even if it's exposed to the sun for a long time.

671.name: Mudsdale
671.dex_entry: This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.

672.name: Dewpider
672.dex_entry: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

673.name: Araquanid
673.dex_entry: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

674.name: Fomantis
674.dex_entry: When the sun rises, Fomantis spreads its four leaves and bathes in the sunlight. The tip of its head has a pleasant aroma.

675.name: Lurantis
675.dex_entry: By masquerading as a bug Pokémon, it lowers the guard of actual bug Pokémon lured in by a scent of sweet flowers. Its sickles bring them down.

676.name: Morelull
676.dex_entry: It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they're dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.

677.name: Shiinotic
677.dex_entry: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

678.name: Salandit
678.dex_entry: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

679.name: Salazzle
679.dex_entry: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

681.name: Stufful
681.dex_entry: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

682.name: Bewear
682.dex_entry: This Pokémon has the habit of hugging its companions. Many Trainers have left this world after their spines were squashed by its hug.

683.name: Bounsweet
683.dex_entry: Although it's too sugary for human consumption, Bounsweet's sweat can be watered down into a juice with just the right amount of sweetness.

684.name: Steenee
684.dex_entry: This Pokémon is always bouncing around energetically. Other Pokémon are attracted by its lively appearance and pleasant aroma.

685.name: Tsareena
685.dex_entry: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.

686.name: Comfey
686.dex_entry: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

687.name: Oranguru
687.dex_entry: People used to mistake Oranguru for a human when they saw it issue command after command to the other Pokémon of the forest.

688.name: Passimian
688.dex_entry: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

689.name: Wimpod
689.dex_entry: Its habitat varies from beaches to seabeds. A natural scavenger, it will gleefully chow down on anything edible, no matter how rotten.

690.name: Golisopod
690.dex_entry: It battles skillfully with its six arms, but spends most of its time peacefully meditating in caves deep beneath the sea.

690.2.name: Mega Golisopod
690.2.dex_entry: It uses four of its arms to fiercely assail its foes. Once they've been pushed to the brink of defeat, it finishes them off with the arms it kept hidden.

691.name: Sandygast
691.dex_entry: Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of sand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fond of the shovel on its head.

692.name: Palossand
692.dex_entry: Heaps of bones lie buried beneath its castle. They came from those whom Palossand drained of vitality and left all dried up.

693.name: Pyukumuku
693.dex_entry: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.

694.name: Minior - Meteor
694.dex_entry: This Pokémon is born in the ozone layer. It falls to the ground once the outer shell enclosing its core grows heavy.

694.2.name: Minior - Core
694.2.dex_entry: It feeds on dust in the atmosphere. The color of its core is said to be determined by the composition of the dust it eats.

695.name: Komala
695.dex_entry: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

696.name: Turtonator
696.dex_entry: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

697.name: Togedemaru
697.dex_entry: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

698.name: Mimikyu
698.dex_entry: A gust of wind revealed what hides under this Pokémon's rag to a passing Trainer, who went home and died painfully that very night.

699.name: Bruxish
699.dex_entry: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

700.name: Drampa
700.dex_entry: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

700.2.name: Mega Drampa
700.2.dex_entry: Drampa's cells have been invigorated, allowing it to regain its youth. It manipulates the atmosphere to summon storms.

701.name: Dhelmise
701.dex_entry: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

702.name: Jangmo-o
702.dex_entry: The scale atop its head is useful for both offense and defense. It bravely stands and faces its foes rather than turning tail, even if its foes are strong.

703.name: Hakamo-o
703.dex_entry: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.

704.name: Kommo-o
704.dex_entry: It bashes its scales to test its opponents' mettle. The sound of struck Kommo-o scales frightens weaker foes and sends them running.

705.name: Skwovet
705.dex_entry: It stores berries in its cheeks. When there are no berries to be found, Skwovet will stuff pebbles into its cheeks to stave off its cravings.

706.name: Greedent
706.dex_entry: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

707.name: Rookidee
707.dex_entry: This valiant Pokémon will challenge any foe, no matter how mighty. Even if that backfires and Rookidee loses, it grows from the experience.

708.name: Corvisquire
708.dex_entry: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

709.name: Corviknight
709.dex_entry: Its wings, now made of steel, are extremely tough. Even if it's attacked mid-flight, Corviknight flies on mightily through the sky, unbothered.

710.name: Blipbug
710.dex_entry: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

711.name: Dottler
711.dex_entry: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

712.name: Orbeetle
712.dex_entry: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

713.name: Nickit
713.dex_entry: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

714.name: Thievul
714.dex_entry: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

715.name: Gossifleur
715.dex_entry: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

716.name: Eldegoss
716.dex_entry: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

717.name: Wooloo
717.dex_entry: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

718.name: Dubwool
718.dex_entry: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

719.name: Chewtle
719.dex_entry: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

720.name: Drednaw
720.dex_entry: Drednaw lurks along the shoreline. When prey come to drink water, Drednaw stretches its neck out and chomps down on them.

721.name: Yamper
721.dex_entry: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

722.name: Boltund
722.dex_entry: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

723.name: Rolycoly
723.dex_entry: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

724.name: Carkol
724.dex_entry: Due to the coal tar created inside it, the heap of coal on Carkol's back never falls apart, even when the Pokémon rolls around at high speeds.

725.name: Coalossal
725.dex_entry: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

726.name: Applin
726.dex_entry: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

727.name: Flapple
727.dex_entry: It flutters around while seeking an opening in the opponent's guard, then attacks by spitting acidic liquid strong enough to melt metal.

728.name: Appletun
728.dex_entry: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

729.name: Dipplin
729.dex_entry: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

730.name: Hydrapple
730.dex_entry: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.

731.name: Silicobra
731.dex_entry: Silicobra's neck pouch, which can inflate and deflate like a balloon, gets more elastic each time Silicobra sheds its skin.

732.name: Sandaconda
732.dex_entry: It will expand its body as much as it can and then contract itself, blasting out sand with enough force to wash away a dump truck.

733.name: Cramorant
733.dex_entry: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

734.name: Arrokuda
734.dex_entry: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

735.name: Barraskewda
735.dex_entry: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

736.name: Toxel
736.dex_entry: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

737.name: Toxtricity - Amped
737.dex_entry: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

737.2.name: Toxtricity - Low Key
737.2.dex_entry: Many youths admire the way this Pokémon listlessly picks fights and keeps its cool no matter what opponent it faces.
