738.name: Sizzlipede
738.dex_entry: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

739.name: Centiskorch
739.dex_entry: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

740.name: Clobbopus
740.dex_entry: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

741.name: Grapploct
741.dex_entry: Grapploct pins opponents to the ground with its prized tentacles. Not even monstrously strong Pokémon can wrestle free from its hold.

742.name: Sinistea
742.dex_entry: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

743.name: Polteageist
743.dex_entry: The tea that composes Polteageist's body has a distinct and enjoyable flavor. Drinking too much, however, can be fatal.

744.name: Hatenna
744.dex_entry: Because the emotions of others constantly flow into its head, this Pokémon prefers environments where no other creatures live.

745.name: Hattrem
745.dex_entry: The moment this Pokémon finds someone who's emitting strong emotions, it will pummel them senseless with its braids to silence them.

746.name: Hatterene
746.dex_entry: Beware of forests that show no signs of living creatures within. You may have wandered into Hatterene's territory.

747.name: Impidimp
747.dex_entry: The reason this Pokémon causes trouble for those it feels close to is because Impidimp itself gets irritable if it can't absorb negative emotions.

748.name: Morgrem
748.dex_entry: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

749.name: Grimmsnarl
749.dex_entry: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

750.name: Milcery
750.dex_entry: When attacked, it tackles its foe and covers them in cream. With its foe either blinded or astonished by deliciousness, Milcery flees.

751.name: Alcremie
751.dex_entry: Desserts that Alcremie have decorated with their cream have a rich, sweet flavor and bring happiness to all who eat them.

752.name: Falinks
752.dex_entry: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

752.2.name: Mega Falinks
752.2.dex_entry: Mega Falinks has taken on the ultimate battle formation, which can be achieved only if the troopers and brass have the strongest of bonds.

753.name: Pincurchin
753.dex_entry: This Pokémon generates electricity when it digests food. It uses its five hard teeth to scrape seaweed off surfaces and eat it.

754.name: Snom
754.dex_entry: Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.

755.name: Frosmoth
755.dex_entry: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

756.name: Stonjourner
756.dex_entry: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

757.name: Eiscue - Ice Face
757.dex_entry: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

757.2.name: Eiscue - Noice
757.2.dex_entry: The ice that was covering this Eiscue's face has shattered. Eiscue emits cold air from the tip of its hair to protect its head, which is sensitive to heat.

758.name: Indeedee - Male
758.dex_entry: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

758.2.name: Indeedee - Female
758.2.dex_entry: They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.

759.name: Morpeko
759.dex_entry: Morpeko eats seeds constantly to keep its hunger at bay. If it's hungry for too long, it grows wild and brutish.

760.name: Cufant
760.dex_entry: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

761.name: Copperajah
761.dex_entry: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

762.name: Dracozolt
762.dex_entry: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

763.name: Arctozolt
763.dex_entry: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

764.name: Dracovish
764.dex_entry: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

765.name: Arctovish
765.dex_entry: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

766.name: Duraludon
766.dex_entry: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

767.name: Archaludon
767.dex_entry: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

768.name: Dreepy
768.dex_entry: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

769.name: Drakloak
769.dex_entry: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it'll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

770.name: Dragapult
770.dex_entry: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult's horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

771.name: Lechonk
771.dex_entry: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

772.name: Oinkologne - Male
772.dex_entry: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

772.2.name: Oinkologne - Female
772.2.dex_entry: This is a meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep things tidy. It shrouds itself in a floral aroma that soothes the Pokémon around it.

773.name: Tarountula
773.dex_entry: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

774.name: Spidops
774.dex_entry: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

775.name: Nymble
775.dex_entry: It's highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

776.name: Lokix
776.dex_entry: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

777.name: Pawmi
777.dex_entry: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

778.name: Pawmo
778.dex_entry: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

779.name: Pawmot
779.dex_entry: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

780.name: Tandemaus
780.dex_entry: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

781.name: Maushold
781.dex_entry: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

782.name: Fidough
782.dex_entry: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

783.name: Dachsbun
783.dex_entry: The surface of this Pokémon's skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

784.name: Smoliv
784.dex_entry: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

785.name: Dolliv
785.dex_entry: It basks in the sun to its heart's content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.

786.name: Arboliva
786.dex_entry: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

787.name: Squawkabilly - Green
787.dex_entry: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

787.2.name: Squawkabilly - Blue
787.2.dex_entry: Blue-feathered Squawkabilly view their green-feathered counterparts as rivals, since the latter make up the largest, most powerful groups.

787.3.name: Squawkabilly - Yellow
787.3.dex_entry: Squawkabilly with yellow plumage grew increasingly aggressive in order to be taken seriously by the more populous varieties.

787.4.name: Squawkabilly - White
787.4.dex_entry: This is the least populous variety of Squawkabilly. They don't like conflict, but when they have to fight, they do so valiantly and resolutely.

788.name: Nacli
788.dex_entry: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli's body.

789.name: Naclstack
789.dex_entry: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.

790.name: Garganacl
790.dex_entry: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

791.name: Charcadet
791.dex_entry: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

792.name: Armarouge
792.dex_entry: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

793.name: Ceruledge
793.dex_entry: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

794.name: Tadbulb
794.dex_entry: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

795.name: Bellibolt
795.dex_entry: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

796.name: Wattrel
796.dex_entry: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

797.name: Kilowattrel
797.dex_entry: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There's hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

798.name: Maschiff
798.dex_entry: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

799.name: Mabosstiff
799.dex_entry: Contrary to appearances, Mabosstiff has a kind heart-but it will relentlessly chase down and put an end to any foe that dares threaten its family.

800.name: Shroodle
800.dex_entry: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

801.name: Grafaiai
801.dex_entry: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

802.name: Bramblin
802.dex_entry: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

803.name: Brambleghast
803.dex_entry: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

804.name: Toedscool
804.dex_entry: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

805.name: Toedscruel
805.dex_entry: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

806.name: Klawf
806.dex_entry: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

807.name: Capsakid
807.dex_entry: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

808.name: Scovillain
808.dex_entry: Its two heads have different temperaments and excel at different fighting styles. Nevertheless, they act in perfect harmony on the battlefield.

808.2.name: Mega Scovillain
808.2.dex_entry: Mega Evolution has dialed up this Pokémon's spiciness. It swings its necktie around to wallop its foes.

809.name: Rellor
809.dex_entry: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

810.name: Rabsca
810.dex_entry: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

811.name: Flittle
811.dex_entry: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

812.name: Espathra
812.dex_entry: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

813.name: Tinkatink
813.dex_entry: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.

814.name: Tinkatuff
814.dex_entry: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.

815.name: Tinkaton
815.dex_entry: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

816.name: Wiglett
816.dex_entry: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.

817.name: Wugtrio
817.dex_entry: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

818.name: Bombirdier
818.dex_entry: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

819.name: Finizen
819.dex_entry: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

820.name: Palafin
820.dex_entry: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

820.2.name: Palafin - Hero
820.2.dex_entry: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

821.name: Varoom
821.dex_entry: The steel section is Varoom's actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

822.name: Revavroom
822.dex_entry: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

823.name: Cyclizar
823.dex_entry: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

824.name: Orthworm
824.dex_entry: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

825.name: Glimmet
825.dex_entry: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

826.name: Glimmora
826.dex_entry: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

826.2.name: Mega Glimmora
826.2.dex_entry: Glimmora's petals, now larger and separated from its main body, rotate around it to provide defense while scattering poisonous fragments.

827.name: Greavard
827.dex_entry: This Pokémon loves to gambol and roughhouse. It rubs its fur up against others and absorbs their life force until they're utterly drained.

828.name: Houndstone
828.dex_entry: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

829.name: Flamigo
829.dex_entry: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

830.name: Cetoddle
830.dex_entry: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

831.name: Cetitan
831.dex_entry: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.

832.name: Veluza
832.dex_entry: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

833.name: Dondozo
833.dex_entry: Although it boasts fantastic strength and a huge body that stirs up great waves when it thrashes, Dondozo struggles at catching prey.

834.name: Tatsugiri - Curly
834.dex_entry: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

834.2.name: Tatsugiri - Droopy
834.2.dex_entry: This species' differing colors and patterns are apparently the result of Tatsugiri changing itself to suit the preferences of the prey it lures in.

834.3.name: Tatsugiri - Stretchy
834.3.dex_entry: Tatsugiri assesses situations using its sharp intellect. If it determines there is no hope of winning, it flees as fast as it can.

834.4.name: Mega Tatsugiri
834.4.dex_entry: Tatsugiri's brain has been invigorated by Mega Evolution, making it even wilier. It can create and command copies of itself.

835.name: Frigibax
835.dex_entry: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

836.name: Arctibax
836.dex_entry: Arctibax is armed with a bladed dorsal fin and a mask made of ice. It is agile in its movements, springing upon foes to deliver slashing attacks.

837.name: Baxcalibur
837.dex_entry: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

837.2.name: Mega Baxcalibur
837.2.dex_entry: Baxcalibur's dorsal blade has grown even more massive thanks to Mega Evolution. This Pokémon fires beams from the hilt at its solar plexus.

838.name: Gimmighoul - Chest
838.dex_entry: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

838.2.name: Gimmighoul - Roaming
838.2.dex_entry: It wanders around, carrying an old coin on its back. It survives by draining the life-force from humans who try to pick up its coin.

839.name: Gholdengo
839.dex_entry: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

840.name: Poltchageist
840.dex_entry: It sprinkles some of its powdery body onto food and drains the life-force from those who so much as lick it.

841.name: Sinistcha
841.dex_entry: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

842.name: Bulbasaur
842.dex_entry: It carries a seed on its back right from birth. As its body grows larger, the seed does too.

843.name: Ivysaur
843.dex_entry: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower's coming bloom.

844.name: Venusaur
844.dex_entry: While it basks in the sun, it can convert the light into energy. As a result, it is more powerful in the summertime.

844.2.name: Mega Venusaur
844.2.dex_entry: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.

845.name: Charmander
845.dex_entry: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

846.name: Charmeleon
846.dex_entry: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

847.name: Charizard
847.dex_entry: Charizard flies around the sky in search of powerful opponents. It breathes fire of such great heat that it melts anything. However, it never turns its fiery breath on any opponent weaker than itself.

847.2.name: Mega Charizard X
847.2.dex_entry: The overwhelming power that fills its entire body causes it to turn black and creates intense blue flames.

847.3.name: Mega Charizard Y
847.3.dex_entry: Its bond with its Trainer is the source of its power. It boasts speed and maneuverability greater than that of a jet.

848.name: Squirtle
848.dex_entry: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It sprays a potent foam from its mouth.

849.name: Wartortle
849.dex_entry: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

850.name: Blastoise
850.dex_entry: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

850.2.name: Mega Blastoise
850.2.dex_entry: The cannon on its back is as powerful as a tank gun. Its tough legs and back enable it to withstand the recoil from firing the cannon.

851.name: Chikorita
851.dex_entry: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.

852.name: Bayleef
852.dex_entry: The spicy scent that wafts from around Bayleef's neck somehow makes those who smell it want to fight.

853.name: Meganium
853.dex_entry: The fragrance of Meganium's flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.

853.2.name: Mega Meganium
853.2.dex_entry: This Pokémon can fire a tremendously powerful Solar Beam from its four flowers. Another name for this is Mega Sol Cannon.

854.name: Cyndaquil
854.dex_entry: The fire that spouts from its back burns hottest when it is angry. The flaring flames intimidate foes.

855.name: Quilava
855.dex_entry: The fur covering this Pokémon's body never burns, no matter what. It can shrug off any kind of fire attack.

856.name: Typhlosion
856.dex_entry: Typhlosion obscures itself behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intensely hot flames. This Pokémon creates blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.

856.2.name: Hisuian Typhlosion
856.2.dex_entry: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. It is believed that its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

857.name: Totodile
857.dex_entry: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

858.name: Croconaw
858.dex_entry: It opens its huge jaws wide to attack. If it loses fangs while biting, they'll just keep on growing back, one after another.

859.name: Feraligatr
859.dex_entry: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

859.2.name: Mega Feraligatr
859.2.dex_entry: With its arms and hoodlike fin, this Pokémon forms a gigantic set of jaws with a bite 10 times as powerful as Mega Feraligatr's actual jaws.

860.name: Treecko
860.dex_entry: Treecko has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This Pokémon attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.

861.name: Grovyle
861.dex_entry: This Pokémon adeptly flies from branch to branch in trees. In a forest, no Pokémon can ever hope to catch a fleeing Grovyle however fast they may be.

862.name: Sceptile
862.dex_entry: Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.

862.2.name: Mega Sceptile
862.2.dex_entry: The seeds on its back are filled with energy from Mega Evolution. The Pokémon detonates these seeds to launch the tip of its tail.

863.name: Torchic
863.dex_entry: Torchic feels toasty warm if you hug it. It has a flame sac inside its belly, and the flames burn continuously as long as Torchic has life in it.

864.name: Combusken
864.dex_entry: Combusken toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This Pokémon's legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out 10 kicks in one second.

865.name: Blaziken
865.dex_entry: In battle, Blaziken blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this Pokémon's wrists burn.

865.2.name: Mega Blaziken
865.2.dex_entry: Boiling-hot blood courses through its entire body, doubling the sharpness of its moves. It subdues opponents in the blink of an eye.

866.name: Mudkip
866.dex_entry: Using the fin on its head, Mudkip senses the flow of water to keep track of what's going on around it. It has the strength to heft boulders.

867.name: Marshtomp
867.dex_entry: It is at its best when on muddy ground that offers poor footing. It quickly overwhelms opponents that are bogged down and unable to move.

868.name: Swampert
868.dex_entry: Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.

868.2.name: Mega Swampert
868.2.dex_entry: The water within its body further strengthens its already enlarged muscles, using the same principles as a hydraulic pump.

869.name: Turtwig
869.dex_entry: It uses its whole body to photosynthesize when exposed to sunlight. Its shell is made from hardened soil.

870.name: Grotle
870.dex_entry: Grotle live in the forest. Each is said to have its own secret place for getting clean springwater.

871.name: Torterra
871.dex_entry: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

872.name: Chimchar
872.dex_entry: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

873.name: Monferno
873.dex_entry: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.

874.name: Infernape
874.dex_entry: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

875.name: Piplup
875.dex_entry: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

876.name: Prinplup
876.dex_entry: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees in half with a single hit.

877.name: Empoleon
877.dex_entry: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will mercilessly decimate anything that threatens the safety of its colony.

878.name: Snivy
878.dex_entry: The leaf on Snivy's tail generates energy when exposed to sunlight, making Snivy swifter and adding an edge to its moves.

879.name: Servine
879.dex_entry: It runs low to the ground, weaving through the grass, then mercilessly pummels its target by whipping them with its vines.

880.name: Serperior
880.dex_entry: It can stop its opponents' movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

881.name: Tepig
881.dex_entry: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

882.name: Pignite
882.dex_entry: When defending its friends, Pignite will stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong. But it's powerless when faced with an empty stomach.

883.name: Emboar
883.dex_entry: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

883.2.name: Mega Emboar
883.2.dex_entry: Brandishing a blazing flame shaped like a serpentine spear, it rushes in to rescue its imperiled allies.

884.name: Oshawott
884.dex_entry: It's said that Oshawott learned to maintain its scalchop with riverbed stones by mimicking humans it saw using whetstones.

885.name: Dewott
885.dex_entry: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

886.name: Samurott
886.dex_entry: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

886.2.name: Hisuian Samurott
886.2.dex_entry: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

887.name: Chespin
887.dex_entry: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

888.name: Quilladin
888.dex_entry: It's protected by a sturdy shell. The shell is also very heavy, which naturally strengthens Quilladin's lower body.

889.name: Chesnaught
889.dex_entry: When its allies are in trouble, Chesnaught creates a shield with its arms and uses its own body to block attacks.

889.2.name: Mega Chesnaught
889.2.dex_entry: It has fortified armor and a will to defend at all costs. Both are absurdly strong.

890.name: Fennekin
890.dex_entry: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

891.name: Braixen
891.dex_entry: It ignites the twig from its tail and waves the twig around to signal its allies. To indicate danger, it draws circles in the air with the twig's flame.

892.name: Delphox
892.dex_entry: It leaves burn marks in the ground with the flame at the tip of its wand. Long ago, people used the shapes of these burn marks for divination.

892.2.name: Mega Delphox
892.2.dex_entry: It wields flaming branches to dazzle its opponents before incinerating them with a huge fireball.

893.name: Froakie
893.dex_entry: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

894.name: Frogadier
894.dex_entry: The tips of its fingers and toes stick firmly to vertical surfaces. Frogadier can scale skyscrapers with ease.

895.name: Greninja
895.dex_entry: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

895.2.name: Mega Greninja
895.2.dex_entry: This Pokémon spins a giant shuriken at high speed to make it float, then clings to it upside down to catch opponents unawares.

896.name: Rowlet
896.dex_entry: Silently it glides, streaking toward its targets to get close to them. Before they even notice it, it begins to pelt them with vicious kicks.

897.name: Dartrix
897.dex_entry: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills

898.name: Decidueye
898.dex_entry: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

898.2.name: Hisuian Decidueye
898.2.dex_entry: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

899.name: Litten
899.dex_entry: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

900.name: Torracat
900.dex_entry: In the midst of battle, the fire pouch on Torracat's neck rings like a bell and produces stronger flames than usual.

901.name: Incineroar
901.dex_entry: After hurling ferocious punches and flinging furious kicks, it finishes opponents off by spewing fire from around its navel.

902.name: Popplio
902.dex_entry: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills.

903.name: Brionne
903.dex_entry: As if dancing, it artfully dodges the attacks of its enemies. All the while, it's busy forming a bunch of balloons to overwhelm its foes.

904.name: Primarina
904.dex_entry: Also known as a songstress, it is a sight to behold on moonlit nights when it sings in front of the colony it leads.

905.name: Grookey
905.dex_entry: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

906.name: Thwackey
906.dex_entry: When it's drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won't even notice that it's already knocked out its opponent.

907.name: Rillaboom
907.dex_entry: Though it has a calm disposition, it won't tolerate those who drum up discord. It strictly disciplines offenders until they learn their lesson.

908.name: Scorbunny
908.dex_entry: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

909.name: Raboot
909.dex_entry: While it prides itself on its varied kicking moves, it can also deliver powerful headbutts once its flames have heated up its forehead.

910.name: Cinderace
910.dex_entry: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

911.name: Sobble
911.dex_entry: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

912.name: Drizzile
912.dex_entry: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

913.name: Inteleon
913.dex_entry: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

914.name: Sprigatito
914.dex_entry: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

915.name: Floragato
915.dex_entry: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

916.name: Meowscarada
916.dex_entry: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining in its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

917.name: Fuecoco
917.dex_entry: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

918.name: Crocalor
918.dex_entry: The valve in Crocalor's flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

919.name: Skeledirge
919.dex_entry: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge's head gained a soul.

920.name: Quaxly
920.dex_entry: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

921.name: Quaxwell
921.dex_entry: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

922.name: Quaquaval
922.dex_entry: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

923.name: Starter Électrik 1
923.dex_entry: LOREM IPSUM DOLOR SIT AMET, CONSECTETUR ADIPISICING ELIT. QUIA, MINIMA.

924.name: Starter Électrik 2
924.dex_entry: LOREM IPSUM DOLOR SIT AMET, CONSECTETUR ADIPISICING ELIT. QUIA, MINIMA.

925.name: Starter Électrik 3
925.dex_entry: LOREM IPSUM DOLOR SIT AMET, CONSECTETUR ADIPISICING ELIT. QUIA, MINIMA.

925.2.name: Starter Électrik 3 - Mega
925.2.dex_entry: LOREM IPSUM DOLOR SIT AMET, CONSECTETUR ADIPISICING ELIT. QUIA, MINIMA.

926.name: Starter Sol 1
926.dex_entry: LOREM IPSUM DOLOR SIT AMET, CONSECTETUR ADIPISICING ELIT. QUIA, MINIMA.

927.name: Starter Sol 2
927.dex_entry: LOREM IPSUM DOLOR SIT AMET, CONSECTETUR ADIPISICING ELIT. QUIA, MINIMA.

928.name: Starter Sol 3
928.dex_entry: LOREM IPSUM DOLOR SIT AMET, CONSECTETUR ADIPISICING ELIT. QUIA, MINIMA.

928.2.name: Starter Sol 3 - Mega
928.2.dex_entry: LOREM IPSUM DOLOR SIT AMET, CONSECTETUR ADIPISICING ELIT. QUIA, MINIMA.

1000.name: Great Tusk
1000.dex_entry: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.

1001.name: Scream Tail
1001.dex_entry: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.

1002.name: Brute Bonnet
1002.dex_entry: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

1003.name: Flutter Mane
1003.dex_entry: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

1004.name: Slither Wing
1004.dex_entry: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.

1005.name: Sandy Shocks
1005.dex_entry: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

1006.name: Roaring Moon
1006.dex_entry: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.

1007.name: Walking Wake
1007.dex_entry: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.

1008.name: Gouging Fire
1008.dex_entry: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.

1009.name: Raging Bolt
1009.dex_entry: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.

1010.name: Koraidon
1010.dex_entry: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

1011.name: Iron Treads
1011.dex_entry: This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific weapon that a paranormal magazine claimed was sent to this planet by aliens.

1012.name: Iron Bundle
1012.dex_entry: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.

1013.name: Iron Hands
1013.dex_entry: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.

1014.name: Iron Jugulis
1014.dex_entry: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

1015.name: Iron Moth
1015.dex_entry: This Pokémon resembles an unknown object described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.

1016.name: Iron Thorns
1016.dex_entry: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.

1017.name: Iron Valiant
1017.dex_entry: It has some similarities to a mad scientist's invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

1018.name: Iron Leaves
1018.dex_entry: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

1019.name: Iron Boulder
1019.dex_entry: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

1020.name: Iron Crown
1020.dex_entry: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

1021.name: Miraidon
1021.dex_entry: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

1022.name: Nihilego
1022.dex_entry: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.

1023.name: Buzzwole
1023.dex_entry: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

1024.name: Pheromosa
1024.dex_entry: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

1025.name: Xurkitree
1025.dex_entry: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.

1026.name: Celesteela
1026.dex_entry: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.

1027.name: Kartana
1027.dex_entry: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

1028.name: Guzzlord
1028.dex_entry: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.

1029.name: Poipole
1029.dex_entry: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

1030.name: Naganadel
1030.dex_entry: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

1031.name: Stakataka
1031.dex_entry: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

1032.name: Blacephalon
1032.dex_entry: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

1033.name: Type: Null
1033.dex_entry: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

1034.name: Silvally
1034.dex_entry: A solid bond of trust between this Pokémon and its Trainer awakened the strength hidden within Silvally. It can change its type at will.

1035.name: Articuno
1035.dex_entry: Articuno is a legendary bird Pokémon that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this Pokémon flies, snow will fall.

1035.2.name: Galarian Articuno
1035.2.dex_entry: Its feather-like blades are composed of psychic energy and can shear through thick iron sheets as if they were paper.

1036.name: Zapdos
1036.dex_entry: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon that has the ability to control electricity. It usually lives in thunderclouds. The Pokémon gains power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.

1036.2.name: Galarian Zapdos
1036.2.dex_entry: One kick from its powerful legs will pulverize a dump truck. Supposedly, this Pokémon runs through the mountains at over 180 mph.

1037.name: Moltres
1037.dex_entry: Moltres is a legendary bird Pokémon that has the ability to control fire. If this Pokémon is injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.

1037.2.name: Galarian Moltres
1037.2.dex_entry: This Pokémon's sinister, flame-like aura will consume the spirit of any creature it hits. Victims become burned-out shadows of themselves.

1038.name: Mewtwo
1038.dex_entry: Mewtwo is a Pokémon that was created by genetic manipulation. However, even though the scientific power of humans created this Pokémon's body, they failed to endow Mewtwo with a compassionate heart.

1038.2.name: Mega Mewtwo X
1038.2.dex_entry: Psychic power has augmented its muscles. It has a grip strength of one ton and can sprint 100 meters in two seconds flat!

1038.3.name: Mega Mewtwo Y
1038.3.dex_entry: Despite its diminished size, its mental power has grown phenomenally. With a mere thought, it can smash a skyscraper to smithereens.

1039.name: Mew
1039.dex_entry: Mew is said to possess the genetic composition of all Pokémon. It is capable of making itself invisible at will, so it entirely avoids notice even if it approaches people.

1040.name: Raikou
1040.dex_entry: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.

1041.name: Entei
1041.dex_entry: Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.

1042.name: Suicune
1042.dex_entry: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.

1043.name: Celebi
1043.dex_entry: This Pokémon came from the future by crossing over time. It is thought that so long as Celebi appears, a bright and shining future awaits us.

1044.name: Regirock
1044.dex_entry: Regirock's body is composed entirely of rocks. Recently, a study made the startling discovery that the rocks were all unearthed from different locations.

1045.name: Regice
1045.dex_entry: Regice cloaks itself with frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit. Things will freeze solid just by going near this Pokémon. Its icy body is so cold, it will not melt even if it is immersed in magma.

1046.name: Registeel
1046.dex_entry: Registeel has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this Pokémon eats.

1047.name: Regieleki
1047.dex_entry: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It's said that removing the rings on Regieleki's body will unleash the Pokémon's latent power.

1048.name: Regidrago
1048.dex_entry: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago's arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.

1049.name: Regigigas
1049.dex_entry: It's said that Regigigas created other Pokémon from many different materials before it moved the continents to where they are today.

1050.name: Latias
1050.dex_entry: Latias is highly sensitive to the emotions of people and communicates its feelings using telepathy. To make itself invisible, it covers its body in down that refracts light.

1050.2.name: Mega Latias
1050.2.dex_entry: Both its flying capabilities and its attack power have increased. It scatters transparent down to confuse its enemies.

1051.name: Latios
1051.dex_entry: Latios will only open its heart to a Trainer with a compassionate spirit. This Pokémon can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.

1051.2.name: Mega Latios
1051.2.dex_entry: It flies at speeds exceeding Mach 4. It is among the top tier of all Pokémon in terms of aerial combat capability.

1052.name: Jirachi
1052.dex_entry: It's believed that when this Pokémon wakes from its 1,000-year slumber, it will grant any wishes written on the notes attached to its head.

1053.name: Deoxys
1053.dex_entry: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon's chest appears to be its brain.

1053.2.name: Deoxys - Attack Form
1053.2.dex_entry: This Deoxys has transformed into its aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by altering its appearance.

1053.3.name: Deoxys - Defense Form
1053.3.dex_entry: When it changes form, an aurora appears. It absorbs attacks by altering its cellular structure.

1053.4.name: Deoxys - Speed Form
1053.4.dex_entry: A Pokémon that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior agility and speed.

1054.name: Uxie
1054.dex_entry: Known as the Being of Knowledge. A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers.

1055.name: Mesprit
1055.dex_entry: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.

1056.name: Azelf
1056.dex_entry: The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.

1057.name: Heatran
1057.dex_entry: Boiling, magma-like blood circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

1057.2.name: Mega Heatran
1057.2.dex_entry: It's said that if it goes all out, it can heat its body up to temperatures over 1.8 million degrees Fahrenheit. This heat keeps enemies at bay.

1058.name: Cresselia
1058.dex_entry: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

1059.name: Darkrai
1059.dex_entry: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

1059.2.name: Mega Darkrai
1059.2.dex_entry: Its dark power blocks out the sun, plunging the surrounding area into darkness. There is no escaping its evil eye.

1060.name: Phione
1060.dex_entry: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.

1061.name: Manaphy
1061.dex_entry: Water makes up 80 percent of its body. This Pokémon is easily affected by its environment.

1062.name: Shaymin
1062.dex_entry: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

1062.2.name: Shaymin - Sky
1062.2.dex_entry: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

1063.name: Victini
1063.dex_entry: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

1064.name: Cobalion
1064.dex_entry: It has a body and heart of steel. One glare from Cobalion can bring even the most ferocious of Pokémon to heel.

1065.name: Terrakion
1065.dex_entry: Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used its phenomenal power to destroy a castle in its effort to protect Pokémon.

1066.name: Virizion
1066.dex_entry: It confounds opponents with its quick movement, darting around them like a whirlwind as it carves them up mercilessly with its sharp horns.

1067.name: Keldeo
1067.dex_entry: By shooting water from its hooves, Keldeo can travel across the water's surface as if skating. It's skilled at using kicking moves in battle.

1067.2.name: Keldeo - Resolute
1067.2.dex_entry: The power that lay hidden in its body now covers its horn, turning it into a sword that can slice through anything.

1068.name: Tornadus
1068.dex_entry: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

1068.2.name: Tornadus - Therian
1068.2.dex_entry: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. Tornadus has been sighted crossing the ocean while in this form.

1069.name: Thundurus
1069.dex_entry: Legends say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.

1069.2.name: Thundurus - Therian
1069.2.dex_entry: Quick as a flash, it materializes out of nowhere. It pulverizes foes into nothingness with showers of devastatingly powerful lightning bolts launched from the string of orbs on its tail.

1070.name: Landorus
1070.dex_entry: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

1070.2.name: Landorus - Therian
1070.2.dex_entry: Landorus soars through the sky in this form, bestowing plentiful harvests upon the land and earning the people's reverence.

1071.name: Enamorus
1071.dex_entry: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across regions.

1071.2.name: Enamorus - Therian
1071.2.dex_entry: A different guise from its feminine humanoid form. From the clouds, it descends upon those who treat any form of life with disrespect and metes out wrathful, ruthless punishment.

1072.name: Meloetta
1072.dex_entry: Sung using a special vocalization technique, Meloetta's songs can manipulate the emotions of those who hear them.

1072.2.name: Meloetta - Pirouette
1072.2.dex_entry: Now that it has reclaimed a long-forgotten song, Meloetta captivates everyone with its enchanting dance steps.

1073.name: Genesect
1073.dex_entry: This bug Pokémon of the Paleozoic era was revived by a certain organization, which also upgraded the cannon on Genesect's back.

1074.name: Diancie
1074.dex_entry: Diancie is a spontaneous mutation of Carbink. Its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

1074.2.name: Mega Diancie
1074.2.dex_entry: This Pokémon is also known as the Royal Pink Princess. The dazzling, sparkling diamond on its forehead is a whopping 2,000 carats.

1075.name: Hoopa
1075.dex_entry: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

1075.2.name: Hoopa - Unbound
1075.2.dex_entry: This is Hoopa's true form, in which it has regained its sealed powers. The hole in its chest is said to connect to another dimension.

1076.name: Volcanion
1076.dex_entry: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

1077.name: Tapu Koko
1077.dex_entry: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

1078.name: Tapu Lele
1078.dex_entry: It heals the wounds of people and Pokémon by sprinkling them with its sparkling scales. This guardian deity is worshiped on Akala.

1079.name: Tapu Bulu
1079.dex_entry: The guardian deity of Ula'ula is a lazy Pokémon. It commands plants to immobilize its foes and then deals them a savage blow with its horns.

1080.name: Tapu Fini
1080.dex_entry: The guardian deity of Poni, it can control water. People say it can create pure water that will wash away any uncleanness.

1081.name: Magearna
1081.dex_entry: This Pokémon was built by a scientist roughly 500 years ago. The part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

1081.2.name: Magearna - Original Color
1081.2.dex_entry: This Magearna looks as it did at the time of its invention. Its magnificent ornamentation delighted the king's daughter.

1081.3.name: Mega Magearna
1081.3.dex_entry: This is Magearna once a previously hidden mode activates. The emotions Magearna had begun to feel now hide away as it fells foe after foe.

1082.name: Marshadow
1082.dex_entry: By slipping into the shadow of a martial arts master and copying their movements, this Pokémon learned the ultimate techniques.

1083.name: Zeraora
1083.dex_entry: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

1083.2.name: Mega Zeraora
1083.2.dex_entry: It stores up 10 lightning strikes' worth of electricity. When it stops limiting itself, it's in the strongest class of electric Pokémon.

1084.name: Meltan
1084.dex_entry: Its body is made up of molten steel. It melts particles of iron and other metals it finds in the ground and absorbs them into itself.

1085.name: Melmetal
1085.dex_entry: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

1086.name: Kubfu
1086.dex_entry: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

1087.name: Urshifu - Single Strike
1087.dex_entry: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

1087.2.name: Urshifu - Rapid Strike
1087.2.dex_entry: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in defeating foes by raining many blows down on them. Its strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.

1088.name: Zarude
1088.dex_entry: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

1089.name: Wo-Chien
1089.dex_entry: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king's evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

1090.name: Chien-Pao
1090.dex_entry: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

1091.name: Ting-Lu
1091.dex_entry: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.

1092.name: Chi-Yu
1092.dex_entry: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

1093.name: Okidogi
1093.dex_entry: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

1094.name: Munkidori
1094.dex_entry: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

1095.name: Fezandipiti
1095.dex_entry: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

1096.name: Pecharunt
1096.dex_entry: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt's control, chained to its will.

1097.name: Ogerpon - Teal Mask
1097.dex_entry: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

1097.2.name: Ogerpon - Wellspring Mask
1097.2.dex_entry: This form excels in both attack and defense. It ceaselessly unleashes moves like a spring gushes water.

1097.3.name: Ogerpon - Hearthflame Mask
1097.3.dex_entry: This form is the most aggressive, bombarding enemies with the intensity of flames blazing within a hearth.

1097.4.name: Ogerpon - Cornerstone Mask
1097.4.dex_entry: This form has excellent defenses, absorbing impacts solidly like the cornerstones that support houses.

1098.name: Terapagos
1098.dex_entry: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.

1098.2.name: Terapagos - Terastal
1098.2.dex_entry: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move's energy and transfers it to Terapagos.

1098.3.name: Terapagos - Stellar
1098.3.dex_entry: An old expedition journal describes the sight of this Pokémon buried in the depths of the earth as resembling a planet floating in space.

1099.name: Glastrier
1099.dex_entry: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

1100.name: Spectrier
1100.dex_entry: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn't use its sense of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to separate soul from body.

1101.name: Calyrex
1101.dex_entry: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

1101.2.name: Calyrex - Ice Rider
1101.2.dex_entry: According to lore, this Pokémon showed no mercy to those who got in its way, yet it would heal its opponents' wounds after battle.

1101.3.name: Calyrex - Shadow Rider
1101.3.dex_entry: Legend says that by using its power to see all events from past to future, this Pokémon saved the creatures of a forest from a meteorite strike.

1102.name: Zacian
1102.dex_entry: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

1102.2.name: Zacian - Crowned Sword
1102.2.dex_entry: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

1103.name: Zamazenta
1103.dex_entry: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

1103.2.name: Zamazenta - Crowned Shield
1103.2.dex_entry: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

1104.name: Eternatus
1104.dex_entry: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

1105.name: Lugia
1105.dex_entry: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

1106.name: Ho-Oh
1106.dex_entry: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

1107.name: Cosmog
1107.dex_entry: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.

1108.name: Cosmoem
1108.dex_entry: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

1109.name: Solgaleo
1109.dex_entry: When light radiates from its body, this Pokémon could almost appear to be the sun. It will dispel any darkness and light up the world.

1110.name: Lunala
1110.dex_entry: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.

1111.name: Necrozma
1111.dex_entry: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.

1111.2.name: Necrozma - Dusk Mane
1111.2.dex_entry: This is its form while it is devouring the light of Solgaleo. It pounces on foes and then slashes them with the claws on its four limbs and back.

1111.3.name: Necrozma - Dawn Wings
1111.3.dex_entry: This is its form while it's devouring the light of Lunala. It grasps foes in its giant claws and rips them apart with brute force.

1111.4.name: Ultra Necrozma
1111.4.dex_entry: This is its form when it has absorbed overwhelming light energy. It fires laser beams from all over its body.

1112.name: Reshiram
1112.dex_entry: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

1113.name: Zekrom
1113.dex_entry: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom's lightning.

1114.name: Kyurem
1114.dex_entry: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.

1114.2.name: Kyurem White
1114.2.dex_entry: The sameness of Reshiram's and Kyurem's genes allowed Kyurem to absorb Reshiram. Kyurem can now use the power of both fire and ice.

1114.3.name: Kyurem Black
1114.3.dex_entry: The sameness of Zekrom's and Kyurem's genes allowed Kyurem to absorb Zekrom. Kyurem can now use the power of both electricity and ice.

1116.name: Xerneas
1116.dex_entry: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

1117.name: Yveltal
1117.dex_entry: It's said that when its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

1118.name: Zygarde - 10%
1118.dex_entry: Its sharp fangs make short work of finishing off its enemies, but it's unable to maintain this body indefinitely. After a period of time, it falls apart.

1118.2.name: Zygarde - 50%
1118.2.dex_entry: This is Zygarde's form when about half of its pieces have been assembled. It plays the role of monitoring the ecosystem.

1118.3.name: Zygarde - Complete Form
1118.3.dex_entry: Born when all of Zygarde's cells have been gathered together, it uses force to neutralize those who harm the ecosystem.

1118.4.name: Mega Zygarde
1118.4.dex_entry: In response to people's emotions during an unprecedented crisis, Zygarde Mega Evolves and calms the situation with its unmatched power.

1119.name: Kyogre
1119.dex_entry: In myths, this Pokémon expanded the seas with torrential rains and great tsunamis. It battled ferociously against Groudon.

1119.2.name: Primal Kyogre
1119.2.dex_entry: Kyogre reverted to this state via the Blue Orb, which contains the energy of the primordial world. Kyogre's body resembles seawater.

1120.name: Groudon
1120.dex_entry: Groudon is said to have expanded the reach of dry land by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled ferociously against Kyogre.

1120.2.name: Primal Groudon
1120.2.dex_entry: This is Groudon's true form, restored using the Red Orb. Energy spills from its body in the form of magma.

1121.name: Rayquaza
1121.dex_entry: A Pokémon that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if Kyogre and Groudon were to fight.

1121.2.name: Mega Rayquaza
1121.2.dex_entry: A shooting star streaking across the night sky may, in fact, be Mega Rayquaza flying gracefully after a meteoroid.

1122.name: Dialga
1122.dex_entry: The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world. This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time, and uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.

1122.2.name: Dialga - Origin
1122.2.dex_entry: Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a form bearing a striking resemblance to the creator Pokémon. Dialga now wields such colossal strength that one must conclude this is its true form.

1123.name: Palkia
1123.dex_entry: The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity. Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.

1123.2.name: Palkia - Origin
1123.2.dex_entry: It soars across the sky in a form that greatly resembles the creator of all things. Perhaps this imitation of appearance is Palkia's strategy for gaining Arceus's powers.

1124.name: Giratina
1124.dex_entry: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

1124.2.name: Giratina - Origin
1124.2.dex_entry: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

1125.name: Arceus
1125.dex_entry: Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things and shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.
